11.7.36.a.m: He should lay them in the first layer for a young man; in the middle [layer] for a middle-aged man; and in the first and the uppermost [layers] for an old man.

11.7.37.a.s: bṛhaspatis tvā sādayatu pṛthivyāḥ pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm iti viśvajyotiṣam / agner yāny asi \ devānām agner yāny asi \\ iti dve saṃyānyau / madhuś ca mādhavaś ca \\ iti dve ṛtavye / samānatayā devate bhavataḥ //
11.7.37.a.d: बृहस्पतिस् त्वा सादयतु पृथिव्याः पृष्ठे ज्योतिष्मतीम् इति विश्वज्योतिषम् । अग्नेर् यान्य् असि \ देवानाम् अग्नेर् यान्य् असि \\ इति द्वे संयान्यौ । मधुश् च माधवश् च \\ इति द्वे ऋतव्ये । समानतया देवते भवतः ॥
11.7.37.a.m: With "May Bṛhaspati seat you on the back of the earth, radiant," [he lays] the all-radiant [brick]. With "You are the path of Agni," and "You are the path of the Agni of the gods," [he lays] two saṃyānī bricks. With "Madhu and Mādhava," [he lays] two seasonal bricks. By their equality, they become two deities.

11.7.38.a.m: He places avakā plants on all the seasonal bricks.

11.7.39.a.s: gharmeṣṭakām upadadhāti / tasyāḥ pravargye mantra āmnātaḥ //
11.7.39.a.d: घर्मेष्टकाम् उपदधाति । तस्याः प्रवर्ग्ये मन्त्र आम्नातः ॥
11.7.39.a.m: He lays the gharma brick; its mantra is handed down in the Pravargya [section].

11.7.40.a.s: aṣāḍhāsi \\ ity upariṣṭāllakṣmāṇam aṣāḍhāṃ dveṣyasyādhastāllakṣmāṇaṃ yās te agna ārdrā yonayo yāḥ kulāyinīḥ / \ ye te agna indavo yā u nābhayaḥ / \ yās te agne tanuva ūrjo nāma \ tābhis tvam ubhayībhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ / \ iha prajānāṃ tanvā niṣīda \\ iti kulāyinīm //
11.7.40.a.d: अषाढासि \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टाल्लक्ष्माणम् अषाढां द्वेष्यस्याधस्ताल्लक्ष्माणं यास् ते अग्न आर्द्रा योनयो याः कुलायिनीः । \ ये ते अग्न इन्दवो या उ नाभयः । \ यास् ते अग्ने तनुव ऊर्जो नाम \ ताभिस् त्वम् उभयीभिः संविदानः । \ इह प्रजानां तन्वा निषीद \\ इति कुलायिनीम् ॥
11.7.40.a.m: With "You are invincible," [he lays] the invincible brick with its mark upward, [or] for one whom he hates with its mark downward. With "Those moist wombs of yours, O Agni, which are nest-like; those drops of yours, O Agni, and which are the navels; those forms of yours, O Agni, named strength—concurring with all those together, sit down here with the body of the creatures," [he lays] the nest-like [brick].

11.7.41.a.s: madhu vātā ṛtāyate \\ iti tisṛbhir dadhnā madhumiśreṇa kūrmam abhyanakti //
11.7.41.a.d: मधु वाता ऋतायते \\ इति तिसृभिर् दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण कूर्मम् अभ्यनक्ति ॥
11.7.41.a.m: With the three [verses beginning with] "The winds blow honey for him who lives by cosmic order," he anoints a tortoise with curd mixed with honey.

11.7.42.a.s: apāṃ gambhīraṃ gaccha \ mā tvā sūryaḥ parītāpsīn mo agnir vaiśvānaraḥ / \ aghoraḥ prajā abhi vipaśya \\ anu tvā divyā vṛṣṭiḥ sacatām // \ sam̐sarpa trīn samudrānt svasalilārgyām̐l lokān \ apāṃpatir vṛṣabha iṣṭakānām / \ tatra gaccha yatra pūrve paretāḥ \ purīṣaṃ vasānaḥ svāṃ yoniṃ yathāyatham ity abhimantrya mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca nas \\ catasra āśās \\ iti dvābhyāṃ purastāt pratyañcaṃ jīvantaṃ prāṅmukha upadadhāti // avakābhiḥ parītasya jālenāvacchādya śaṅkubhiḥ pariṇihanti //
11.7.42.a.d: अपां गम्भीरं गच्छ \ मा त्वा सूर्यः परीताप्सीन् मो अग्निर् वैश्वानरः । \ अघोरः प्रजा अभि विपश्य \\ अनु त्वा दिव्या वृष्टिः सचताम् ॥ \ सम्̐सर्प त्रीन् समुद्रान्त् स्वसलिलार्ग्याम्̐ल् लोकान् \ अपांपतिर् वृषभ इष्टकानाम् । \ तत्र गच्छ यत्र पूर्वे परेताः \ पुरीषं वसानः स्वां योनिं यथायथम् इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य मही द्यौः पृथिवी च नस् \\ चतस्र आशास् \\ इति द्वाभ्यां पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चं जीवन्तं प्राङ्मुख उपदधाति ॥ अवकाभिः परीतस्य जालेनावच्छाद्य शङ्कुभिः परिणिहन्ति ॥
11.7.42.a.m: Having addressed [it] with: "Go to the deep of the waters; let not the sun scorch you, nor Agni Vaiśvānara; look upon the creatures without causing terror; may heavenly rain accompany you. Move through the three oceans, the waters of your own world, the lord of waters, the bull among bricks; go there where the forefathers departed, wearing the mantle of earth, to your own womb properly," facing east, he places it living in the front, facing west, with the two [verses beginning with] "May the great heaven and earth of ours," [and] "The four quarters." Having covered [it] with a net enveloped in avakā plants, he fastens it down with pegs.

11.7.43.a.s: yac cid dhi tvaṃ gṛhegṛhe \\ ulūkhalaka yujyase / \ iha dyumattama vada \ jayatām iva dundubhis \\ iti dakṣiṇasyām̐ śroṇyām ulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ prayunakti //
11.7.43.a.d: यच् चिद् धि त्वं गृहेगृहे \\ उलूखलक युज्यसे । \ इह द्युमत्तम वद \ जयताम् इव दुन्दुभिस् \\ इति दक्षिणस्याम्̐ श्रोण्याम् उलूखलं मुसलं प्रयुनक्ति ॥
11.7.43.a.m: With "Since you are employed in house after house, O mortar, speak here most resplendently, like the drum of victors," he sets the mortar and the pestle upon the right hip [of the altar].

11.7.44.a.s: audumbaraṃ prādeśamātraṃ catuḥsrakty ulūkhalam aparimitaṃ musalaṃ bhavati //
11.7.44.a.d: औदुम्बरं प्रादेशमात्रं चतुःस्रक्त्य् उलूखलम् अपरिमितं मुसलं भवति ॥
11.7.44.a.m: The mortar is made of udumbara wood, a span in size, and four-cornered; the pestle is of unmeasured size.

11.7.45.a.s: uta sma te vanaspate \ vāto vivāty agram iti / atho indrāya pātave \ sunu somam ulūkhala \\ iti sarvauṣadhasya pūrayitvāvahanti //
11.7.45.a.d: उत स्म ते वनस्पते \ वातो विवात्य् अग्रम् इति । अथो इन्द्राय पातवे \ सुनु सोमम् उलूखल \\ इति सर्वौषधस्य पूरयित्वावहन्ति ॥
11.7.45.a.m: With "And truly for you, O tree, the wind blows along the top," [and] "Then for Indra to drink, press the soma, O mortar," having filled [it] with all kinds of herbs, he pounds them.

11.7.46.a.s: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam iti madhye 'gner ulūkhalaṃ musalam upadadhāti viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata \\ iti vā musalam //
11.7.46.a.d: तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम् इति मध्ये ऽग्नेर् उलूखलं मुसलम् उपदधाति विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत \\ इति वा मुसलम् ॥
11.7.46.a.m: With "That highest step of Viṣṇu," he places the mortar and the pestle in the middle of the fire-altar; or the pestle with "Look upon the deeds of Viṣṇu."

11.7.47.a.m: With "Either from heaven, O Viṣṇu," [he places] the winnowing basket.

11.7.48.a.m: He fills the fire-pot with sand,

11.7.49.a.m: or with curd, honey, or clarified butter.

11.7.50.a.s: yaṃ kāmayeta kṣodhuk syād ity ūnāṃ tasyopadadhyāt / yaṃ kāmayetānupadasyad annam adyād iti pūrṇāṃ tasyopadadhyāt //
11.7.50.a.d: यं कामयेत क्षोधुक् स्याद् इत्य् ऊनां तस्योपदध्यात् । यं कामयेतानुपदस्यद् अन्नम् अद्याद् इति पूर्णां तस्योपदध्यात् ॥
11.7.50.a.m: For him whom he wishes: 'May he be hungry,' he should lay it deficient; for him whom he wishes: 'May he eat inexhaustible food,' he should lay it full.

11.7.51.a.s: syūtā devebhir amṛtenāgās \\ ukhām̐ svasāram adhi vedim asthāt / \ satyaṃ pūrvair ṛṣibhiś cākṛpāṇas \\ agniḥ pravidvān iha tat karotu \\ ity ukhām ādāya dhruvāsi pṛthivī \\ iti ca // pṛthivī pṛthivyām̐ sīda \ mātā mātari mātā \ syonā syonāyām \\ kratur devānāṃ mahimānam īmahe \\ agnim̐ sadhasthe sadaneṣu sukratuḥ / \ vaiśvānaraṃ brahmaṇā viśvavyacasam \\ stomasya dhāman nihitaṃ purīṣyam // \ samiddham agnim̐ samidhā samidhyase \\ agnim̐ sadhasthe sadaneṣv acyutam // \ vaiśvānaraṃ brahmaṇā viśvavyacasam \\ stomasya dhāma nidadhe purīṣyam / \ nyayur mātrayā kavayo vayodhasas \\ agnim̐ sadhasthe sadaneṣv āhutam // \ vaiśvānaraṃ brahmaṇā viśvavyacasam \\ stomasya dhāman pavamānam ābhṛtam // \ dhruvāsi pṛthivī \ tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda \\ iti madhye 'gner ukhām upadadhāti //
11.7.51.a.d: स्यूता देवेभिर् अमृतेनागास् \\ उखाम्̐ स्वसारम् अधि वेदिम् अस्थात् । \ सत्यं पूर्वैर् ऋषिभिश् चाकृपाणस् \\ अग्निः प्रविद्वान् इह तत् करोतु \\ इत्य् उखाम् आदाय ध्रुवासि पृथिवी \\ इति च ॥ पृथिवी पृथिव्याम्̐ सीद \ माता मातरि माता \ स्योना स्योनायाम् \\ क्रतुर् देवानां महिमानम् ईमहे \\ अग्निम्̐ सधस्थे सदनेषु सुक्रतुः । \ वैश्वानरं ब्रह्मणा विश्वव्यचसम् \\ स्तोमस्य धामन् निहितं पुरीष्यम् ॥ \ समिद्धम् अग्निम्̐ समिधा समिध्यसे \\ अग्निम्̐ सधस्थे सदनेष्व् अच्युतम् ॥ \ वैश्वानरं ब्रह्मणा विश्वव्यचसम् \\ स्तोमस्य धाम निदधे पुरीष्यम् । \ न्ययुर् मात्रया कवयो वयोधसस् \\ अग्निम्̐ सधस्थे सदनेष्व् आहुतम् ॥ \ वैश्वानरं ब्रह्मणा विश्वव्यचसम् \\ स्तोमस्य धामन् पवमानम् आभृतम् ॥ \ ध्रुवासि पृथिवी \ तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद \\ इति मध्ये ऽग्नेर् उखाम् उपदधाति ॥
11.7.51.a.m: Having taken the fire-pot with "Sewn by the gods with immortality she has come, the fire-pot, a sister, has mounted the altar; true to his promise with the ancient seers, let Agni the wise do that here," and [with] "You are the firm earth," [and] with "O earth, sit on the earth; mother, in the mother; gracious one, on the gracious one; we seek the greatness, the wisdom of the gods; Agni, wise in wisdom in the common dwelling, in the abodes, Vaiśvānara with sacred formulation, all-pervading, deposited in the realm of the chant, belonging to the earth-mound. The kindled Agni, you are kindled with firewood, Agni in the common dwelling, unshakeable in the abodes, Vaiśvānara with sacred formulation, all-pervading, the realm of the chant is laid down, belonging to the earth-mound. In proper measure the poets, givers of life, approached Agni in the common dwelling, who is offered to in the abodes, Vaiśvānara with sacred formulation, all-pervading, brought as the purifying one in the realm of the chant. You are the firm earth; by that deity sit firm like the Aṅgirases," he lays the fire-pot in the middle of the fire-altar.

11.7.53.a.s: agne yukṣvā hi ye tava \\ iti yuktavatībhyām // ukhāyām ekāhutiṃ juhoti //
11.7.53.a.d: अग्ने युक्ष्वा हि ये तव \\ इति युक्तवतीभ्याम् ॥ उखायाम् एकाहुतिं जुहोति ॥
11.7.53.a.m: With the two [verses] containing [the word] "yoke": "O Agni, yoke those [steeds] of yours," he makes a single libation into the fire-pot.

11.7.54.a.s: puruṣaśirasaḥ prāṇeṣu hiraṇyaśalkān pratyasyati / ṛce tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇe 'kṣikaṭe / ruce tvā \\ ity uttare bhāse tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇasyāṃ nāsikāyāṃ jyotiṣe tvā \\ ity uttarasyām abhūd idaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya vājinam ity āsye \\ agnir jyotiṣā jyotiṣmān iti dakṣiṇe karṇe rukmo varcasā varcasvān ity uttare //
11.7.54.a.d: पुरुषशिरसः प्राणेषु हिरण्यशल्कान् प्रत्यस्यति । ऋचे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणे ऽक्षिकटे । रुचे त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरे भासे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणस्यां नासिकायां ज्योतिषे त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरस्याम् अभूद् इदं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य वाजिनम् इत्य् आस्ये \\ अग्निर् ज्योतिषा ज्योतिष्मान् इति दक्षिणे कर्णे रुक्मो वर्चसा वर्चस्वान् इत्य् उत्तरे ॥
11.7.54.a.m: He throws gold chips into the vital openings of the human head: with "For the Ṛgveda, to you" into the right eye-socket; with "For splendor, to you" into the left; with "For luster, to you" into the right nostril; with "For light, to you" into the left; with "This spirited one of the whole world has arisen" into the mouth; with "Agni radiant with light" into the right ear; with "The gold ornament lustrous with luster" into the left.

11.7.55.a.s: sam it sravanti sarito na dhenās \\ iti śṛtātaṅkyena dadhnā madhumiśreṇa puruṣaśiraḥ pūrayitvā sahasradhā asi \ sahasrāya tvā \\ ity ādāya \\ ādityaṃ garbhaṃ payasā samañjan \\ ity ukhāyām uttānaṃ prākcubukam upadadhāti //
11.7.55.a.d: सम् इत् स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेनास् \\ इति शृतातङ्क्येन दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण पुरुषशिरः पूरयित्वा सहस्रधा असि \ सहस्राय त्वा \\ इत्य् आदाय \\ आदित्यं गर्भं पयसा समञ्जन् \\ इत्य् उखायाम् उत्तानं प्राक्चुबुकम् उपदधाति ॥
11.7.55.a.m: Having filled the human head with curd from boiled milk curded by adding milk, mixed with honey, with "Streams flow together like milch cows," and taking it with "You are thousandfold; to the thousand you," he lays it in the fire-pot face upward with the chin pointing eastward, with "Anointing the sun, the embryo, with milk."

11.7.56.a.s: ud u tyaṃ citram iti sauryarcābhyām akṣikaṭayor abhijuhoti //
11.7.56.a.d: उद् उ त्यं चित्रम् इति सौर्यर्चाभ्याम् अक्षिकटयोर् अभिजुहोति ॥
11.7.56.a.m: With the two verses addressed to Sūrya, "Up that [god]" [and] "The wondrous [face of the gods]," he offers over the two eye-sockets.

11.7.58.a.s: yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syād iti viṣūcīnāni tasyopadadhyāt / yaṃ kāmayeta paśumānt syād iti samīcīnāni tasyopadadhyāt / yaṃ kāmayeta kanīyo 'syānnam̐ syād iti saṃtarāṃ tasya paśuśīrṣāṇy upadadhyāt // yaṃ kāmayeta samāvad asyānnam̐ syād ity abhitas tasya svayamātṛṇṇām upadadhyāt / yaṃ kāmayeta bhūyo 'syānnam̐ syād ity anteṣu tasya vyuduhyopadadhyāt //
11.7.58.a.d: यं कामयेतापशुः स्याद् इति विषूचीनानि तस्योपदध्यात् । यं कामयेत पशुमान्त् स्याद् इति समीचीनानि तस्योपदध्यात् । यं कामयेत कनीयो ऽस्यान्नम्̐ स्याद् इति संतरां तस्य पशुशीर्षाण्य् उपदध्यात् ॥ यं कामयेत समावद् अस्यान्नम्̐ स्याद् इत्य् अभितस् तस्य स्वयमातृण्णाम् उपदध्यात् । यं कामयेत भूयो ऽस्यान्नम्̐ स्याद् इत्य् अन्तेषु तस्य व्युदुह्योपदध्यात् ॥
11.7.58.a.m: For him whom he wishes: 'May he be without cattle,' he should lay them facing away; for him whom he wishes: 'May he possess cattle,' he should lay them facing together; for him whom he wishes: 'May his food be scanty,' he should lay the animal heads closer together; for him whom he wishes: 'May his food be of equal measure,' he should lay them on both sides of the naturally perforated [brick]; for him whom he wishes: 'May his food be abundant,' he should lay them, having pushed them apart, at the edges.

11.7.59.a.s: vātasya dhrajim iti purastāt pratīcīnam aśvasyopadadhāti / ajasram indum iti paścāt prācīnam ṛṣabhasya / varūtriṃ tvaṣṭus \\ iti dakṣiṇata udīcīnaṃ vṛṣṇer uttarato vā dakṣiṇam \\ yo agnir agner ity uttarato dakṣiṇaṃ bastasya dakṣiṇato vodīcīnaṃ tāny utsargair avyavāyan pradakṣiṇam anu parikrāman pratidiśam upatiṣṭhate // imaṃ mā him̐sīr dvipādam iti puruṣasya / imaṃ mā him̐sīr ekaśapham ity aśvasya / imam̐ samudram ity ṛṣabhasya / imām ūrṇāyum iti vṛṣṇeḥ / ajā hy agner iti bastasya //
11.7.59.a.d: वातस्य ध्रजिम् इति पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीनम् अश्वस्योपदधाति । अजस्रम् इन्दुम् इति पश्चात् प्राचीनम् ऋषभस्य । वरूत्रिं त्वष्टुस् \\ इति दक्षिणत उदीचीनं वृष्णेर् उत्तरतो वा दक्षिणम् \\ यो अग्निर् अग्नेर् इत्य् उत्तरतो दक्षिणं बस्तस्य दक्षिणतो वोदीचीनं तान्य् उत्सर्गैर् अव्यवायन् प्रदक्षिणम् अनु परिक्रामन् प्रतिदिशम् उपतिष्ठते ॥ इमं मा हिम्̐सीर् द्विपादम् इति पुरुषस्य । इमं मा हिम्̐सीर् एकशफम् इत्य् अश्वस्य । इमम्̐ समुद्रम् इत्य् ऋषभस्य । इमाम् ऊर्णायुम् इति वृष्णेः । अजा ह्य् अग्नेर् इति बस्तस्य ॥
11.7.59.a.m: With [the mantra] "The rush of the wind…", he places [the head] of the horse in the east, facing west; with "The unceasing drop…", [the head] of the bull in the west, facing east; with "The guardian wife of Tvaṣṭṛ…", [the head] of the ram in the south facing north, or in the north facing south; with "Which fire of fire…", [the head] of the he-goat in the north facing south, or in the south facing north. Stepping around them clockwise without crossing between them, he worships them in each direction with the release-mantras: with "Injure not this two-footed [creature]…", [the head] of the man; with "Injure not this single-hoofed [creature]…", [the head] of the horse; with "This ocean…", [the head] of the bull; with "This woolly [creature]…", [the head] of the ram; with "The she-goat is indeed of Agni…", [the head] of the he-goat.

11.7.60.a.m: Now, if there is the head of [the beast] sacred to Vāyu:

11.7.61.a.s: mukhyasthāne sarvair upadhāya sarvair utsargair upatiṣṭhate //
11.7.61.a.d: मुख्यस्थाने सर्वैर् उपधाय सर्वैर् उत्सर्गैर् उपतिष्ठते ॥
11.7.61.a.m: having placed it in the primary position with all [the mantras], he worships it with all the release-mantras;

11.7.62.a.m: or, having placed it in the respective place of each, he worships it with the respective release-mantra of each.

11.7.63.a.s: namo astu sarpebhyas \\ ity eteṣām ekenottare 'm̐se sarpaśira upadadhāti / viṣūcīnaṃ paśuśirobhiḥ //
11.7.63.a.d: नमो अस्तु सर्पेभ्यस् \\ इत्य् एतेषाम् एकेनोत्तरे ऽम्̐से सर्पशिर उपदधाति । विषूचीनं पशुशिरोभिः ॥
11.7.63.a.m: With one of these [mantras beginning with] "Homage be to the serpents…", he places the head of a serpent on the northern shoulder, facing away from the animal heads.

11.7.64.a.m: Or rather, he should only utter the yajus formula and not place [the head].

11.7.65.a.s: mā chandas \ tat pṛthivī \\ agnir devatā \ tenarṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda / \ pramā chandas \ tad antarikṣam \\ vāto devatā / \ pratimā chandas \ tad dyauḥ \ sūryo devatā / \ asrīviś chandas \ tad diśaḥ \ somo devatā / \ virāṭ chandas \ tac cakṣuḥ \ pūṣā devatā / \ gāyatrī chandas \ tad ajā \ bṛhaspatir devatā / \ triṣṭub chandas \ tad dhiraṇyam \ indro devatā / \ jagatī chandas \ tad gauḥ \ prajāpatir devatā / \ anuṣṭup chandas \ tad vāk \\ varuṇo devatā / \ uṣṇihā chandas \ tad āyur \ mitro devatā / \ paṅktiś chandas \ tat kṛṣiḥ \ parjanyo devatā / \ bṛhatī chandas \ tad aśvaḥ \ parameṣṭhī devatā \ tenarṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda \\ iti dvādaśabhis trir abhyāvartayan ṣaṭtrim̐śatā purastāt pratīcīṃ puruṣākṛtiṃ citiṃ cinoti //
11.7.65.a.d: मा छन्दस् \ तत् पृथिवी \\ अग्निर् देवता \ तेनर्षिणा तेन ब्रह्मणा तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद । \ प्रमा छन्दस् \ तद् अन्तरिक्षम् \\ वातो देवता । \ प्रतिमा छन्दस् \ तद् द्यौः \ सूर्यो देवता । \ अस्रीविश् छन्दस् \ तद् दिशः \ सोमो देवता । \ विराट् छन्दस् \ तच् चक्षुः \ पूषा देवता । \ गायत्री छन्दस् \ तद् अजा \ बृहस्पतिर् देवता । \ त्रिष्टुब् छन्दस् \ तद् धिरण्यम् \ इन्द्रो देवता । \ जगती छन्दस् \ तद् गौः \ प्रजापतिर् देवता । \ अनुष्टुप् छन्दस् \ तद् वाक् \\ वरुणो देवता । \ उष्णिहा छन्दस् \ तद् आयुर् \ मित्रो देवता । \ पङ्क्तिश् छन्दस् \ तत् कृषिः \ पर्जन्यो देवता । \ बृहती छन्दस् \ तद् अश्वः \ परमेष्ठी देवता \ तेनर्षिणा तेन ब्रह्मणा तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद \\ इति द्वादशभिस् त्रिर् अभ्यावर्तयन् षट्त्रिम्̐शता पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीं पुरुषाकृतिं चितिं चिनोति ॥
11.7.65.a.m: Repeating [them] three times, with thirty-six [formulas comprising these] twelve: "Mā is the metre, that is the earth, Agni is the deity; with that seer, with that sacred word, with that deity, sit firm like Aṅgiras! / Pramā is the metre, that is the atmosphere, Vāta is the deity… / Pratimā is the metre, that is the sky, Sūrya is the deity… / Asrīviś is the metre, that is the quarters, Soma is the deity… / Virāj is the metre, that is the eye, Pūṣan is the deity… / Gāyatrī is the metre, that is the she-goat, Bṛhaspati is the deity… / Triṣṭubh is the metre, that is the gold, Indra is the deity… / Jagatī is the metre, that is the cow, Prajāpati is the deity… / Anuṣṭubh is the metre, that is speech, Varuṇa is the deity… / Uṣṇih is the metre, that is life, Mitra is the deity… / Paṅkti is the metre, that is agriculture, Parjanya is the deity… / Bṛhatī is the metre, that is the horse, Parameṣṭhin is the deity; with that seer, with that sacred word, with that deity, sit firm like Aṅgiras!", he piles a layer in the shape of a man, from the east towards the west.

11.7.66.a.m: The head of the man becomes its head.

11.7.67.a.s: tam upadhāya sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ \ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt \\ iti puruṣeṇa nārāyaṇenopatiṣṭhate //
11.7.67.a.d: तम् उपधाय सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः \ सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् \\ इति पुरुषेण नारायणेनोपतिष्ठते ॥
11.7.67.a.m: Having placed it, he worships it with the Puruṣasūkta by Nārāyaṇa: "The Puruṣa has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet…"

11.8.1.a.s: apasyā upadadhāti / apāṃ tvemant sādayāmi \\ iti pañca purastāt pratīcīḥ / arṇave sadane sīda \\ iti pañca dakṣiṇata udīcīḥ / apāṃ tvā sadane sādayāmi \\ iti pañca paścāt prācīḥ / gāyatrī chandas \\ iti pañcottarato dakṣiṇāḥ //
11.8.1.a.d: अपस्या उपदधाति । अपां त्वेमन्त् सादयामि \\ इति पञ्च पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीः । अर्णवे सदने सीद \\ इति पञ्च दक्षिणत उदीचीः । अपां त्वा सदने सादयामि \\ इति पञ्च पश्चात् प्राचीः । गायत्री छन्दस् \\ इति पञ्चोत्तरतो दक्षिणाः ॥
11.8.1.a.m: He places the Apasyā bricks: five in the east facing west with "I settle thee in the pathway of the waters…"; five in the south facing north with "Sit in the watery seat…"; five in the west facing east with "I settle thee in the seat of the waters…"; five in the north facing south with "Gāyatrī is the metre…"

11.8.2.a.s: ye yajñaṃ samagṛbhṇan \ devā devebhyaḥ pari / \ tān gāyatrī nayatu prajānatī \ svarge loke amṛtaṃ duhānā / \ ye jyotīm̐ṣi saṃdadhati \ svar ārohanto amṛtasya lokam / \ te yantu prajānantas \\ yajñaṃ vidānāḥ sukṛtasya loke / \ ye paśavo medhyāsas \\ yajñasya yonim abhisaṃbabhūvuḥ / \ tān dadante kavayo vipaścitas \\ yajñaṃ vidānāḥ sukṛtasya loke / \ yaḥ panthā vitato devayānas \\ chandobhir vigṛhīta eti / \ tenātiṣṭhad divam antarikṣam \\ yajñaṃ gṛhītvā sukṛtasya lokam / \ yo yajñaḥ sahasradhāras \\ dyāvāpṛthivyor adhi nirmitaḥ / \ tenaitu yajamānaḥ svastyā \ divo 'dhi pṛṣṭham asthāt \\ iti pañca hiraṇyeṣṭakāś catasraḥ pratidiśam ekāṃ madhye //
11.8.2.a.d: ये यज्ञं समगृभ्णन् \ देवा देवेभ्यः परि । \ तान् गायत्री नयतु प्रजानती \ स्वर्गे लोके अमृतं दुहाना । \ ये ज्योतीम्̐षि संदधति \ स्वर् आरोहन्तो अमृतस्य लोकम् । \ ते यन्तु प्रजानन्तस् \\ यज्ञं विदानाः सुकृतस्य लोके । \ ये पशवो मेध्यासस् \\ यज्ञस्य योनिम् अभिसंबभूवुः । \ तान् ददन्ते कवयो विपश्चितस् \\ यज्ञं विदानाः सुकृतस्य लोके । \ यः पन्था विततो देवयानस् \\ छन्दोभिर् विगृहीत एति । \ तेनातिष्ठद् दिवम् अन्तरिक्षम् \\ यज्ञं गृहीत्वा सुकृतस्य लोकम् । \ यो यज्ञः सहस्रधारस् \\ द्यावापृथिव्योर् अधि निर्मितः । \ तेनैतु यजमानः स्वस्त्या \ दिवो ऽधि पृष्ठम् अस्थात् \\ इति पञ्च हिरण्येष्टकाश् चतस्रः प्रतिदिशम् एकां मध्ये ॥
11.8.2.a.m: [With the verses:] "Those gods who gathered the sacrifice together from the gods, / let the discerning Gāyatrī lead them, yielding immortality in the heavenly world. / Those who unite the lights, ascending to the light, to the world of immortality, / let them go discerning, knowing the sacrifice, in the world of the well-done. / Those sacrificial animals who were born towards the womb of the sacrifice, / the wise sages offer them, knowing the sacrifice, in the world of the well-done. / The path that is stretched out, travelled by the gods, which goes divided by the metres, / by that he reached heaven and atmosphere, having grasped the sacrifice, to the world of the well-done. / The sacrifice with a thousand streams, which was fashioned upon heaven and earth, / by that let the sacrificer go safely; he has stood upon the back of heaven"—with these [verses he places] five gold bricks: four in each direction and one in the middle.

11.8.3.a.s: āyave svāhā \ yoṣkṛte svāhā \ yoṣyatvane svāhā \ viṣṇave svāhā \ bṛhaspataye svāhā \\ iti pañca hiraṇyeṣṭakāś catasraḥ pratidiśam ekāṃ madhye / trivṛt te agne śiras tan me agne śiraḥ \ pañcadaśau te agne bāhū tau me agne bāhū \ saptadaśas te agna ātmā sa me agna ātmā \\ ekavim̐śau te agna ūrū tau me agna ūrū \ triṇavau te agne 'ṣṭhīvantau tau me agne 'ṣṭhīvantau \ trayastrim̐śaṃ te agne pratiṣṭhānaṃ tan me agne pratiṣṭhānam ity etāḥ śirasi pakṣāt puccheṣu śroṇyor am̐sayor upadadhāti / trivṛtte agne śiras tena mābhipāhi \ pañcadaśau te agne bāhū tābhyāṃ mābhipāhi \ sapatadaśas te agna ātmā tena mābhipāhi \\ ekavim̐śau te agna ūrū tābhyāṃ mābhipāhi \ triṇavau te agne 'ṣṭhīvantau tābhyāṃ mābhipāhi \ trayastrim̐śaṃ te agne pratiṣṭhānaṃ tena mābhipāhi \\ ity upahitā yajamāno 'numantrayate //
11.8.3.a.d: आयवे स्वाहा \ योष्कृते स्वाहा \ योष्यत्वने स्वाहा \ विष्णवे स्वाहा \ बृहस्पतये स्वाहा \\ इति पञ्च हिरण्येष्टकाश् चतस्रः प्रतिदिशम् एकां मध्ये । त्रिवृत् ते अग्ने शिरस् तन् मे अग्ने शिरः \ पञ्चदशौ ते अग्ने बाहू तौ मे अग्ने बाहू \ सप्तदशस् ते अग्न आत्मा स मे अग्न आत्मा \\ एकविम्̐शौ ते अग्न ऊरू तौ मे अग्न ऊरू \ त्रिणवौ ते अग्ने ऽष्ठीवन्तौ तौ मे अग्ने ऽष्ठीवन्तौ \ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं ते अग्ने प्रतिष्ठानं तन् मे अग्ने प्रतिष्ठानम् इत्य् एताः शिरसि पक्षात् पुच्छेषु श्रोण्योर् अम्̐सयोर् उपदधाति । त्रिवृत्ते अग्ने शिरस् तेन माभिपाहि \ पञ्चदशौ ते अग्ने बाहू ताभ्यां माभिपाहि \ सपतदशस् ते अग्न आत्मा तेन माभिपाहि \\ एकविम्̐शौ ते अग्न ऊरू ताभ्यां माभिपाहि \ त्रिणवौ ते अग्ने ऽष्ठीवन्तौ ताभ्यां माभिपाहि \ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं ते अग्ने प्रतिष्ठानं तेन माभिपाहि \\ इत्य् उपहिता यजमानो ऽनुमन्त्रयते ॥
11.8.3.a.m: With "To Āyu hail! To the maker of union hail! To unity hail! To Viṣṇu hail! To Bṛhaspati hail!", [he places] five gold bricks: four in each direction and one in the middle. With "The threefold [stoma] is thy head, O Agni; that is my head, O Agni; the fifteenfold [stoma] is thy two arms, O Agni; those are my two arms, O Agni; the seventeenfold [stoma] is thy trunk, O Agni; that is my trunk, O Agni; the twenty-onefold [stoma] is thy two thighs, O Agni; those are my two thighs, O Agni; the thrice-ninefold [stoma] is thy two knees, O Agni; those are my two knees, O Agni; the thirty-threefold [stoma] is thy support, O Agni; that is my support, O Agni"—these he places on the head, on the wings, on the tail, on the hips, and on the shoulders. The sacrificer recites over them when placed: "The threefold [stoma] is thy head, O Agni; by that protect me! The fifteenfold [stoma] is thy two arms; by them protect me! The seventeenfold [stoma] is thy trunk, O Agni; by that protect me! The twenty-onefold [stoma] is thy two thighs, O Agni; by them protect me! The thrice-ninefold [stoma] is thy two knees, O Agni; by them protect me! The thirty-threefold [stoma] is thy support; by that protect me!"

11.8.4.a.s: adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ pṛthivyai rasāc ca \ viśvakarmaṇaḥ samavartatādhi / \ tasya tvaṣṭā vidadhad rūpam eti \ tat puruṣasya viśvam ājānam agre \\ ity etām upadhāya \\ ṛtasad asi \ satyasad asi \ tejaḥsad asi \ varcaḥsad asi \ yaśaḥsad asi \ gṛṇānāsi / \ dhāmāsi \ dhāmyai tvā \ dhāmabhyas tvā \ dhāmasu sīda / \ sanir asi \ sanyai tvā saneyam / \ vittir asi \ vittyai tvā videyam / \ śktir asi \ śaktyai tvā śakeyam / \ bhūtir asi \ bhūtyai tvā bhūyāsam / \ karmāsi \ karmaṇe tvā kriyāsam / \ gūrdo 'si \ gūrdāya tvā \ gūrdebhyas tvā \ gūrde sīda /
11.8.4.a.d: अद्भ्यः संभूतः पृथिव्यै रसाच् च \ विश्वकर्मणः समवर्तताधि । \ तस्य त्वष्टा विदधद् रूपम् एति \ तत् पुरुषस्य विश्वम् आजानम् अग्रे \\ इत्य् एताम् उपधाय \\ ऋतसद् असि \ सत्यसद् असि \ तेजःसद् असि \ वर्चःसद् असि \ यशःसद् असि \ गृणानासि । \ धामासि \ धाम्यै त्वा \ धामभ्यस् त्वा \ धामसु सीद । \ सनिर् असि \ सन्यै त्वा सनेयम् । \ वित्तिर् असि \ वित्त्यै त्वा विदेयम् । \ श्क्तिर् असि \ शक्त्यै त्वा शकेयम् । \ भूतिर् असि \ भूत्यै त्वा भूयासम् । \ कर्मासि \ कर्मणे त्वा क्रियासम् । \ गूर्दो ऽसि \ गूर्दाय त्वा \ गूर्देभ्यस् त्वा \ गूर्दे सीद ।
11.8.4.a.m: Having placed this [brick] with "Produced from the waters and from the sap of the earth, he came into being from Viśvakarman; / Tvaṣṭṛ, fashioning his form, approaches; that was the entire origin of the Puruṣa in the beginning", [he recites:] "Thou art seated in truth; thou art seated in reality; thou art seated in fiery energy; thou art seated in splendour; thou art seated in fame; thou art praised; thou art the abode; for the abode [I set] thee; for the abodes [I set] thee; sit in the abodes! Thou art acquisition; for acquisition may I acquire thee! Thou art finding; for finding may I find thee! Thou art ability; for ability may I be able for thee! Thou art prosperity; for prosperity may I prosper! Thou art ritual action; for ritual action may I perform thee! Thou art exultation; for exultation [I set] thee; for the exultations [I set] thee; sit in exultation!

11.8.4.b.s: kṣatraṃ pāhi \ kṣatraṃ pinva \ kṣatraṃ jinva \ kṣatraṃ yaccha \ kṣatraṃ dṛm̐ha \ kṣatram asi \ kṣatrāya tvā \ kṣatrebhyas tvā \ kṣatre sīda /
11.8.4.b.d: क्षत्रं पाहि \ क्षत्रं पिन्व \ क्षत्रं जिन्व \ क्षत्रं यच्छ \ क्षत्रं दृम्̐ह \ क्षत्रम् असि \ क्षत्राय त्वा \ क्षत्रेभ्यस् त्वा \ क्षत्रे सीद ।
11.8.4.b.m: Protect dominion! Swell dominion! Animate dominion! Bestow dominion! Strengthen dominion! Thou art dominion; for dominion [I set] thee; for dominions [I set] thee; sit in dominion!

11.8.4.c.s: viśveṣu tvā pārthiveṣu sādayāmi / \ viśveṣu tvāntarikṣeṣu sādayāmi / \ viśveṣu tvā divyeṣu sādayāmi / \ viśveṣu tvā deveṣu sādayāmi / \ viśvāsu tvāpsu sādayāmi / \ viśvāsu tvaupadhīṣu sādayāmi / \ viśveṣu tvā vanaspatiṣu sādayāmi / \ viśvāsu tvā dikṣu sādayāmi /
11.8.4.c.d: विश्वेषु त्वा पार्थिवेषु सादयामि । \ विश्वेषु त्वान्तरिक्षेषु सादयामि । \ विश्वेषु त्वा दिव्येषु सादयामि । \ विश्वेषु त्वा देवेषु सादयामि । \ विश्वासु त्वाप्सु सादयामि । \ विश्वासु त्वौपधीषु सादयामि । \ विश्वेषु त्वा वनस्पतिषु सादयामि । \ विश्वासु त्वा दिक्षु सादयामि ।
11.8.4.c.m: I seat thee among all earthly things! I seat thee among all things in the atmosphere! I seat thee among all heavenly things! I seat thee among all gods! I seat thee in all waters! I seat thee in all plants! I seat thee in all trees! I seat thee in all quarters!"

11.8.4.d.s: divi sīda / \ svarjid asi \ pṛtanājid asi \ bhūrijid asi \\ abhijid asi \ viśvajid asi \ sarvajid asi \ satrājid asi \ dhanajid asi \ bhrāḍ asi \ vibhrāḍ asi \ prabhrāḍ asi /
11.8.4.d.d: दिवि सीद । \ स्वर्जिद् असि \ पृतनाजिद् असि \ भूरिजिद् असि \\ अभिजिद् असि \ विश्वजिद् असि \ सर्वजिद् असि \ सत्राजिद् असि \ धनजिद् असि \ भ्राड् असि \ विभ्राड् असि \ प्रभ्राड् असि ।
11.8.4.d.m: "Sit in heaven! / You are the winner of heaven. / You are the winner of battles. / You are the winner of much. / You are the winner of all around. / You are the winner of everything. / You are the winner of all. / You are the winner in assemblies. / You are the winner of wealth. / You are shining. / You are radiant. / You are brightly radiant."

11.8.4.e.s: sapatnahanaṃ tvā vajram̐ sādayāmi / \ ābhimātihanaṃ tvā vajram̐ sādayāmi / \ arātihanaṃ tvā vajram̐ sādayāmi / \ yātuhanaṃ tvā vajram̐ sādayāmi / \ piśācahanaṃ tvā vajram̐ sādayāmi / \ rakṣohaṇaṃ tvā vajram̐ sādayāmi / \ śatruhaṇam amitrahaṇaṃ bhrātṛvyahaṇam asurahaṇaṃ tvendraṃ vajram̐ sādayāmi / \ udvad asi \\ uditir asi \\ udyaty asi \\ ākramamāṇāsi \\ ākrāmanty asi \\ ākrāntir asi \ saṃkramamāṇāsi \ saṃkrāmanty asi \ saṃkrāntir asi \ svargyāsi \ svar asi /
11.8.4.e.d: सपत्नहनं त्वा वज्रम्̐ सादयामि । \ आभिमातिहनं त्वा वज्रम्̐ सादयामि । \ अरातिहनं त्वा वज्रम्̐ सादयामि । \ यातुहनं त्वा वज्रम्̐ सादयामि । \ पिशाचहनं त्वा वज्रम्̐ सादयामि । \ रक्षोहणं त्वा वज्रम्̐ सादयामि । \ शत्रुहणम् अमित्रहणं भ्रातृव्यहणम् असुरहणं त्वेन्द्रं वज्रम्̐ सादयामि । \ उद्वद् असि \\ उदितिर् असि \\ उद्यत्य् असि \\ आक्रममाणासि \\ आक्रामन्त्य् असि \\ आक्रान्तिर् असि \ संक्रममाणासि \ संक्रामन्त्य् असि \ संक्रान्तिर् असि \ स्वर्ग्यासि \ स्वर् असि ।
11.8.4.e.m: "I set you, a thunderbolt, slaying rivals. / I set you, a thunderbolt, slaying enemies. / I set you, a thunderbolt, slaying adversaries. / I set you, a thunderbolt, slaying sorcerers. / I set you, a thunderbolt, slaying piśācas. / I set you, a thunderbolt, slaying rakṣases. / I set you, Indra, a thunderbolt, slaying foes, slaying enemies, slaying rivals, slaying asuras. / You are ascending. / You are an ascent. / You are rising up. / You are striding forth. / You are marching forward. / You are an advance. / You are stepping across. / You are traversing. / You are a transition. / You are heavenly. / You are heaven."

11.8.4.f.s: iṣi sīda \\ ūrji sīda \ bhage sīda \ draviṇe sīda \ subhūte sīda \ pṛthivyā yajñiye sīda \ viṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭhe sīda \\ iḍāyāḥ pade sīda \ ghṛtavati sīda \ pinvamāne sīda / \ saṃvatsare sīda \ parivatsare sīda \\ iḍāvatsare sīda \\ iduvatsare sīda \\ idvatsare sīda \ vatsare sīda / \ ekasyām̐ sīda \ daśasu sīda \ śate sīda \ sahasre sīda \\ ayute sīda \ niyute sīda \ prayute sīda \\ arbude sīda \ nyarbude sīda \ samudre sīda \ madhye sīda \ padme sīda \\ ante sīda \ parārdhe sīda /
11.8.4.f.d: इषि सीद \\ ऊर्जि सीद \ भगे सीद \ द्रविणे सीद \ सुभूते सीद \ पृथिव्या यज्ञिये सीद \ विष्णोः पृष्ठे सीद \\ इडायाः पदे सीद \ घृतवति सीद \ पिन्वमाने सीद । \ संवत्सरे सीद \ परिवत्सरे सीद \\ इडावत्सरे सीद \\ इदुवत्सरे सीद \\ इद्वत्सरे सीद \ वत्सरे सीद । \ एकस्याम्̐ सीद \ दशसु सीद \ शते सीद \ सहस्रे सीद \\ अयुते सीद \ नियुते सीद \ प्रयुते सीद \\ अर्बुदे सीद \ न्यर्बुदे सीद \ समुद्रे सीद \ मध्ये सीद \ पद्मे सीद \\ अन्ते सीद \ परार्धे सीद ।
11.8.4.f.m: "Sit in refreshment! / Sit in strength! / Sit in fortune! / Sit in wealth! / Sit in prosperity! / Sit on what is fit for sacrifice of the earth! / Sit on the back of Viṣṇu! / Sit in the place of Iḍā! / Sit in the clarified butter! / Sit in the swelling! / Sit in the year (saṃvatsara)! / Sit in the full year (parivatsara)! / Sit in the iḍāvatsara! / Sit in the iduvatsara! / Sit in the idvatsara! / Sit in the vatsara! / Sit in the one! / Sit in the ten! / Sit in the hundred! / Sit in the thousand! / Sit in the ten thousand! / Sit in the hundred thousand! / Sit in the million! / Sit in the ten million! / Sit in the hundred million! / Sit in the billion! / Sit in the middle! / Sit in the ten billion! / Sit at the end! / Sit in the highest number!"

11.8.4.g.s: pinvamānāsi \ pinvamānāya tvā \ pinvamānebhyas tvā \ pinvamāne sīda / \ ṛtam asi \\ ṛtāya tvā \\ ṛtebhyas tvā \\ ṛte sīda / \ satyam asi \ satyāya tvā \ satyebhyas tvā \ satye sīda / \ saṃdhir asi saṃdhaye tvā \ saṃdhibhyas tvā \ saṃdhiṣu sīda / \ sam̐śliḍ asi \ sam̐śliṣe tvā \ sam̐śliḍbhyas tvā \ sam̐śliṭsu sīda / \ saṃpad asi \ saṃpade tvā \ saṃpadbhyas tvā \ saṃpatsu sīda \\ ity etābhyām anuvākābhyām ṛṣīṣṭakā upadadhāti //
11.8.4.g.d: पिन्वमानासि \ पिन्वमानाय त्वा \ पिन्वमानेभ्यस् त्वा \ पिन्वमाने सीद । \ ऋतम् असि \\ ऋताय त्वा \\ ऋतेभ्यस् त्वा \\ ऋते सीद । \ सत्यम् असि \ सत्याय त्वा \ सत्येभ्यस् त्वा \ सत्ये सीद । \ संधिर् असि संधये त्वा \ संधिभ्यस् त्वा \ संधिषु सीद । \ सम्̐श्लिड् असि \ सम्̐श्लिषे त्वा \ सम्̐श्लिड्भ्यस् त्वा \ सम्̐श्लिट्सु सीद । \ संपद् असि \ संपदे त्वा \ संपद्भ्यस् त्वा \ संपत्सु सीद \\ इत्य् एताभ्याम् अनुवाकाभ्याम् ऋषीष्टका उपदधाति ॥
11.8.4.g.m: "You are swelling. / To what is swelling, [I place] you. / To those that are swelling, [I place] you. / Sit in what is swelling! / You are truth. / To truth, [I place] you. / To the truths, [I place] you. / Sit in truth! / You are real. / To reality, [I place] you. / To realities, [I place] you. / Sit in reality! / You are junction. / To junction, [I place] you. / To junctions, [I place] you. / Sit in junctions! / You are adhesion. / To adhesion, [I place] you. / To adhesions, [I place] you. / Sit in adhesions! / You are fulfillment. / To fulfillment, [I place] you. / To fulfillments, [I place] you. / Sit in fulfillments!"—with these two anuvākas he lays down the ṛṣi-bricks.

11.8.5.a.s: ayaṃ puro bhuvas \\ iti pañcāśataṃ prāṇabhṛtaḥ / daśadaśa pratidiśam akṣṇayā daśa / madhye bāhyāṃbāhyām upadhāyāntarāmantarām upadadhāti //
11.8.5.a.d: अयं पुरो भुवस् \\ इति पञ्चाशतं प्राणभृतः । दशदश प्रतिदिशम् अक्ष्णया दश । मध्ये बाह्यांबाह्याम् उपधायान्तरामन्तराम् उपदधाति ॥
11.8.5.a.m: With "This one in front, the earthly…" [he lays down] fifty prāṇabhṛt bricks: ten in each quarter and ten diagonally. Having laid each outer one in the middle, he lays [the others] one between another.

11.8.6.a.s: prācī diśāṃ vasanta ṛtūnām iti pañcāśatam apānabhṛto yathā prāṇabhṛto 'ntarāmantarām upadhāya bāhyāṃbāhyām upadadhāti //
11.8.6.a.d: प्राची दिशां वसन्त ऋतूनाम् इति पञ्चाशतम् अपानभृतो यथा प्राणभृतो ऽन्तरामन्तराम् उपधाय बाह्यांबाह्याम् उपदधाति ॥
11.8.6.a.m: With "The eastern among the directions, the spring among the seasons…" [he lays down] fifty apānabhṛt bricks; like the prāṇabhṛt bricks, having laid [them] one between another, he lays each outer one.

11.8.7.a.m: He lays down the prāṇabhṛt and apānabhṛt bricks diverging [from each other].

11.8.8.a.s: āyuṣaḥ prāṇam̐ saṃtanu \\ ity etenānuvākena saṃyata upadadhāti //
11.8.8.a.d: आयुषः प्राणम्̐ संतनु \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन संयत उपदधाति ॥
11.8.8.a.m: With this anuvāka, "Extend the out-breath from lifetime…", he lays down the saṃyata bricks.

11.8.9.a.s: pṛthivy asi janmanā vaśā \ sāgniṃ garbham adhatthāḥ \ sā mayā saṃbhava / \ dyaur asi janmanā vaśā \ sādityaṃ garbham adhatthāḥ \ sā mayā saṃbhava / \ nakṣatrāṇy asi janmanā vaśā \ sā candramasaṃ garbham adhatthāḥ \ sā mayā saṃbhava / \ āpo 'si janmanā vaśā \ sā varuṇaṃ garbham adhatthāḥ \ sā mayā saṃbhava / \ auṣadho 'si janmanā vaśā \ sā somam̐ rājānaṃ garbham adhatthāḥ sā mayā saṃbhava / \ vayovinir asi janmanā vaśā \ sā mahyaṃ garbham adhatthāḥ \ sā mayā saṃbhava / \ virāḍ asi janmanā vaśā \ sā rājānaṃ garbham adhatthāḥ \ sā mayā saṃbhava \\ ity ete nānuvākena vaśeṣṭakā upadadhāti //
11.8.9.a.d: पृथिव्य् असि जन्मना वशा \ साग्निं गर्भम् अधत्थाः \ सा मया संभव । \ द्यौर् असि जन्मना वशा \ सादित्यं गर्भम् अधत्थाः \ सा मया संभव । \ नक्षत्राण्य् असि जन्मना वशा \ सा चन्द्रमसं गर्भम् अधत्थाः \ सा मया संभव । \ आपो ऽसि जन्मना वशा \ सा वरुणं गर्भम् अधत्थाः \ सा मया संभव । \ औषधो ऽसि जन्मना वशा \ सा सोमम्̐ राजानं गर्भम् अधत्थाः सा मया संभव । \ वयोविनिर् असि जन्मना वशा \ सा मह्यं गर्भम् अधत्थाः \ सा मया संभव । \ विराड् असि जन्मना वशा \ सा राजानं गर्भम् अधत्थाः \ सा मया संभव \\ इत्य् एते नानुवाकेन वशेष्टका उपदधाति ॥
11.8.9.a.m: "You are the earth, a barren cow by birth; you held Agni as embryo; unite with me! / You are heaven, a barren cow by birth; you held Āditya as embryo; unite with me! / You are the lunar mansions, a barren cow by birth; you held the moon as embryo; unite with me! / You are the waters, a barren cow by birth; you held Varuṇa as embryo; unite with me! / You are the plants, a barren cow by birth; you held King Soma as embryo; unite with me! / You are the age-bestowers, a barren cow by birth; you held me as embryo; unite with me! / You are the virāj, a barren cow by birth; you held the king as embryo; unite with me!"—with this anuvāka he lays down the vaśā-bricks.

11.8.10.a.s: yā devy asīṣṭaka āyurdā upaśīvarī / sā mām upaveśeṣu jāyeva patim it sadā // \ yā devy asīṣṭake prāṇadā apānadā vyānadāś cakṣurdāḥ śrotradāḥ pṛthividā antarikṣadā dyaurdāḥ suvardāḥ kumarīdāḥ prapharvīdā yuvatidā upaśīvarī / sā mām upaveśeṣu jāyeva patim it sadā \\ ity etenānuvākenopaśīvarīr upadadhāti //
11.8.10.a.d: या देव्य् असीष्टक आयुर्दा उपशीवरी । सा माम् उपवेशेषु जायेव पतिम् इत् सदा ॥ \ या देव्य् असीष्टके प्राणदा अपानदा व्यानदाश् चक्षुर्दाः श्रोत्रदाः पृथिविदा अन्तरिक्षदा द्यौर्दाः सुवर्दाः कुमरीदाः प्रफर्वीदा युवतिदा उपशीवरी । सा माम् उपवेशेषु जायेव पतिम् इत् सदा \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेनोपशीवरीर् उपदधाति ॥
11.8.10.a.m: "O brick, you who are a goddess, life-giving, lying near; / may she ever [be] with me in sittings, like a wife with her husband. // / O brick, you who are a goddess, breath-giving, down-breath-giving, through-breath-giving, eye-giving, ear-giving, earth-giving, atmosphere-giving, heaven-giving, light-giving, girl-giving, wanton-giving, maiden-giving, lying near; / may she ever [be] with me in sittings, like a wife with her husband."—with this anuvāka he lays down the upaśīvarī bricks.

11.8.11.a.s: arthetaḥ sthādhvagatas \\ agner vas tejiṣṭhena tejasā devatābhir gṛhṇāmi / \ śukrāḥ stha vīryāvatīs \\ indrasya va indriyāvato devatābhir gṛhṇāmi / \ adhipatnīḥ stha tejasvinīs \\ ādityānāṃ vo devānāṃ devatābhir gṛhṇāmi / \ mandrāḥ sthābhibhuvas \\ viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ devatābhir gṛhṇāmi / \ kṣatrabhṛtaḥ sthaujasvinīs \\ mitrāvaruṇayor brahmaṇā devatābhir gṛhṇāmi / \ brajakṣitaḥ stha ūrdhvaśritas \\ bṛhaspater vo brahmaṇā devatābhir gṛhṇāmi \\ iti dvādaśa kumbheṣṭakā adbhiḥ pūrayitvā ṣaṭ kumbhān ṣaṭ kumbhīr hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakās \\ ity etenānuvākena pratimantraṃ kumbhaṃm kumbhīṃ ca pratidiśam anusītam upadadhāti / catasro madhye //
11.8.11.a.d: अर्थेतः स्थाध्वगतस् \\ अग्नेर् वस् तेजिष्ठेन तेजसा देवताभिर् गृह्णामि । \ शुक्राः स्थ वीर्यावतीस् \\ इन्द्रस्य व इन्द्रियावतो देवताभिर् गृह्णामि । \ अधिपत्नीः स्थ तेजस्विनीस् \\ आदित्यानां वो देवानां देवताभिर् गृह्णामि । \ मन्द्राः स्थाभिभुवस् \\ विश्वेषां देवानां देवताभिर् गृह्णामि । \ क्षत्रभृतः स्थौजस्विनीस् \\ मित्रावरुणयोर् ब्रह्मणा देवताभिर् गृह्णामि । \ ब्रजक्षितः स्थ ऊर्ध्वश्रितस् \\ बृहस्पतेर् वो ब्रह्मणा देवताभिर् गृह्णामि \\ इति द्वादश कुम्भेष्टका अद्भिः पूरयित्वा षट् कुम्भान् षट् कुम्भीर् हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयः पावकास् \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन प्रतिमन्त्रं कुम्भंम् कुम्भीं च प्रतिदिशम् अनुसीतम् उपदधाति । चतस्रो मध्ये ॥
11.8.11.a.m: "You are going with a purpose, you are on the road; with the brightest brilliance of Agni, with the deities I take you. / You are radiant, full of vigor; with the deities of Indra endowed with vigor I take you. / You are sovereign rulers, brilliant; with the deities, the gods, the Ādityas, I take you. / You are delightful, all-overcoming; with the deities of the Viśvedevas I take you. / You are realm-sustaining, mighty; through the sacred utterance of Mitra and Varuṇa, with the deities I take you. / You dwell in the enclosure, raised high; through the sacred utterance of Bṛhaspati I take you."—having filled twelve jar-bricks with water—six large jars and six small jars—with this anuvāka, "Golden-colored, pure, purifying…", mantra by mantra, he lays down a large jar and a small jar in each direction along the furrow, and four in the middle.

11.8.12.a.s: divi śrayasva \\ antarikṣe yatasva \\ iti bārhaspatyaṃ naivāraṃ caruṃ payasi śṛtaṃ madhye kumbheṣṭakānām //
11.8.12.a.d: दिवि श्रयस्व \\ अन्तरिक्षे यतस्व \\ इति बार्हस्पत्यं नैवारं चरुं पयसि शृतं मध्ये कुम्भेष्टकानाम् ॥
11.8.12.a.m: With 'Rest in heaven,' [and] 'Strive in the intermediate region,' [he places] a caru of wild rice sacred to Bṛhaspati, cooked in milk, in the middle of the jar-bricks.

11.8.13.a.s: tejase vām \\ varcase vām \\ cakṣuṣe vām \\ jyotiṣe vām \\ retase vām \\ prajābhyo vām iti dvaudvau hiraṇyaśakalāv upāsyati //
11.8.13.a.d: तेजसे वाम् \\ वर्चसे वाम् \\ चक्षुषे वाम् \\ ज्योतिषे वाम् \\ रेतसे वाम् \\ प्रजाभ्यो वाम् इति द्वौद्वौ हिरण्यशकलाव् उपास्यति ॥
11.8.13.a.m: With 'For your splendor,' 'For your luster,' 'For your sight,' 'For your light,' 'For your seed,' [and] 'For your offspring,' he throws in two gold chips each time.

11.8.14.a.s: tvām agne vṛṣabhaṃ cekitānam ity ṛṣabhaṃ hiraṇyaśakalaṃ citau prāsya citim acitiṃ cinavat \\ iti citikḷptyābhimṛśati //
11.8.14.a.d: त्वाम् अग्ने वृषभं चेकितानम् इत्य् ऋषभं हिरण्यशकलं चितौ प्रास्य चितिम् अचितिं चिनवत् \\ इति चितिकॢप्त्याभिमृशति ॥
11.8.14.a.m: With 'Thee, O Agni, the perceiving bull,' having thrown a bull-[shaped] gold chip onto the layer, he touches it with the citikḷpti formula: 'He shall pile the piling and the unpiled.'

11.8.15.a.s: yat te 'citaṃ yad u citaṃ te agne \ yad ūnaṃ yad vātrātiriktam / \ viśve devā aṅgirasaś cinvan \\ ādityās te citim āpūrayantu // \ yās te agne samidhaḥ // \ cittim acittim / \ vayam agne dhanavantaḥ syāma \\ alaṃ yajñāyota dakṣiṇāyai / \ grāvā vaded abhi somasyām̐śunā \\ indraṃ śikṣemendunā sutena // \ rāyaspoṣaṃ no dhehi jātavedas \\ ūrjo bhāgaṃ madhumat sūnṛtāvat / \ dadhāma yajñaṃ sunavāma somam \\ yajñena tvām upaśikṣema śakra // \ īśānaṃ tvā śuśrumo vayam \\ dhanānāṃ dhanapate \ gomad agne / aśvāvad bhūri puṣṭam \\ hiraṇyavad annam adhyehi mahyam // \ duhāṃ te dyauḥ pṛthivī payas \\ ajagaras tvā sodako visarpatu / \ prajāpatinātmānam \ āprīṇe rikto ma ātmā / \ yo rudro agnau yo apsu ya oṣadhīṣu \ yo rudro viśvā bhuvanāviveśa \ tasmai rudrāya namo astu devās \\ iti saptabhiḥ svayaṃcityābhimṛśya lokaṃpṛṇābhiḥ pracchādayati //
11.8.15.a.d: यत् ते ऽचितं यद् उ चितं ते अग्ने \ यद् ऊनं यद् वात्रातिरिक्तम् । \ विश्वे देवा अङ्गिरसश् चिन्वन् \\ आदित्यास् ते चितिम् आपूरयन्तु ॥ \ यास् ते अग्ने समिधः ॥ \ चित्तिम् अचित्तिम् । \ वयम् अग्ने धनवन्तः स्याम \\ अलं यज्ञायोत दक्षिणायै । \ ग्रावा वदेद् अभि सोमस्याम्̐शुना \\ इन्द्रं शिक्षेमेन्दुना सुतेन ॥ \ रायस्पोषं नो धेहि जातवेदस् \\ ऊर्जो भागं मधुमत् सूनृतावत् । \ दधाम यज्ञं सुनवाम सोमम् \\ यज्ञेन त्वाम् उपशिक्षेम शक्र ॥ \ ईशानं त्वा शुश्रुमो वयम् \\ धनानां धनपते \ गोमद् अग्ने । अश्वावद् भूरि पुष्टम् \\ हिरण्यवद् अन्नम् अध्येहि मह्यम् ॥ \ दुहां ते द्यौः पृथिवी पयस् \\ अजगरस् त्वा सोदको विसर्पतु । \ प्रजापतिनात्मानम् \ आप्रीणे रिक्तो म आत्मा । \ यो रुद्रो अग्नौ यो अप्सु य ओषधीषु \ यो रुद्रो विश्वा भुवनाविवेश \ तस्मै रुद्राय नमो अस्तु देवास् \\ इति सप्तभिः स्वयंचित्याभिमृश्य लोकंपृणाभिः प्रच्छादयति ॥
11.8.15.a.m: Having touched [the layer] with the seven svayaṃciti formulas: 'What of thee is unpiled, and what of thee is piled, O Agni, / what is deficient, or what is excessive here, / may all the gods, the Aṅgirases, pile it; / may the Ādityas fill up thy pile,' 'Those kindling-sticks of thine, O Agni,' 'The thought, the non-thought,' 'May we, O Agni, be wealthy, / sufficient for the sacrifice and for the priestly gift; / may the press-stone sound forth with the soma shoot; / may we serve Indra with pressed juice,' 'Bestow on us prosperity in wealth, O Jātavedas, / a share of vigor sweet and true; / may we establish the sacrifice, may we press soma; / through sacrifice may we serve thee, O mighty one,' 'We have heard of thee as ruler / of riches, O lord of wealth; / rich in cattle, O Agni, rich in horses, abundant nourishment / rich in gold, food assign unto me,' 'May heaven and earth yield milk for thee; / may a water-bearing python glide along towards thee; / with Prajāpati [I satisfy] myself; / I satisfy [thee]; empty is my self,' [and] 'The Rudra who is in the fire, who is in the waters, who is in the plants, / the Rudra who entered into all the worlds, / to that Rudra be homage, O gods,' he covers it with lokaṃpṛṇā bricks.

11.8.16.a.m: He places each lokaṃpṛṇā brick with two mantras each.

11.8.17.a.m: Having placed [it] with the first [mantra], he touches it with the sūdadohas [verse].

11.8.18.a.m: For all bricks, he finally places [the brick] with the tayādevata formula.

11.8.19.a.s: kṛṣṇo 'śvaḥ śyāvo vottaratas tiṣṭhati / tam ālabhya cātvālāt purīṣam āhṛtya pṛṣṭo divi \\ ity anuvyūhati //
11.8.19.a.d: कृष्णो ऽश्वः श्यावो वोत्तरतस् तिष्ठति । तम् आलभ्य चात्वालात् पुरीषम् आहृत्य पृष्टो दिवि \\ इत्य् अनुव्यूहति ॥
11.8.19.a.m: A black or dark brown horse stands to the north. Touching it and having brought loose earth from the cātvāla pit, he scatters it around with 'Established in heaven.'

11.8.21.a.s: yo apsv antar agnir yo vṛtre \ yaḥ puruṣe yo aśmani / \ ya āviveśa bhuvanāni viśvā \ tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat / \ yam̐ hutādam agniṃ yam u kāmam āhur \ yaṃ dātāraṃ pratigrahītāram āhuḥ / \ yo devānāṃ devatamas tapojās \ tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat / \ pṛṣṭo divi \\ ity eṣā / yaḥ some antar yo goṣv antar \ vayām̐si ya āviveśa yo mṛgeṣu / \ ya āviveśa dvipado yaś catuṣpadas \ tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat / \ yenendrasya ratham̐ saṃbabhūvur \ yo vaiśvānara uta vaiśvadevyaḥ // \ dhīro yaḥ śakraḥ paribhūr adābhyas \ tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat / \ ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya \\ iti ṣaḍbhiś citiṃcitim upadhāyābhi juhoti //
11.8.21.a.d: यो अप्स्व् अन्तर् अग्निर् यो वृत्रे \ यः पुरुषे यो अश्मनि । \ य आविवेश भुवनानि विश्वा \ तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतम् अस्त्व् एतत् । \ यम्̐ हुतादम् अग्निं यम् उ कामम् आहुर् \ यं दातारं प्रतिग्रहीतारम् आहुः । \ यो देवानां देवतमस् तपोजास् \ तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतम् अस्त्व् एतत् । \ पृष्टो दिवि \\ इत्य् एषा । यः सोमे अन्तर् यो गोष्व् अन्तर् \ वयाम्̐सि य आविवेश यो मृगेषु । \ य आविवेश द्विपदो यश् चतुष्पदस् \ तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतम् अस्त्व् एतत् । \ येनेन्द्रस्य रथम्̐ संबभूवुर् \ यो वैश्वानर उत वैश्वदेव्यः ॥ \ धीरो यः शक्रः परिभूर् अदाभ्यस् \ तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतम् अस्त्व् एतत् । \ उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय \\ इति षड्भिश् चितिंचितिम् उपधायाभि जुहोति ॥
11.8.21.a.m: With the six [verses]: 'The fire which is within the waters, which is in Vṛtra, / which is in man, which is in stone, / which entered all the worlds, / to those fires let this be offered,' 'Which fire they call the eater of oblations, and which desire, / which giver and which receiver they call him, / who is the most divine of gods, born of heat, / to those fires let this be offered,' this [verse] 'Established in heaven,' 'Which is within soma, which is within cattle, / which entered birds, which in wild beasts, / which entered two-footed [creatures] and which four-footed, / to those fires let this be offered,' 'With which they became Indra's chariot, / who is Vaiśvānara and belonging to all the gods, / who is wise, mighty, all-encompassing, unassailable, / to those fires let this be offered,' [and] 'For him whose food is oxen, whose food is barren cows,' having laid each layer, he offers an oblation upon it.

11.8.22.a.s: evam etāny ata ūrdhvam ṛṣabhaprabhṛtīni sarveṣu cityante samānāni kriyante //
11.8.22.a.d: एवम् एतान्य् अत ऊर्ध्वम् ऋषभप्रभृतीनि सर्वेषु चित्यन्ते समानानि क्रियन्ते ॥
11.8.22.a.m: Thus these [rites] beginning with the bull [gold chip] are performed identically at the end of every layer from here onwards.

11.8.23.a.s: āgneyyā gāyatriyā prathamāṃ citim abhimṛśet / triṣṭubhā dvitīyām / jagatyā tṛtīyām / anuṣṭubhā caturthīm / paṅktyā pañcamīm / sarvāsāṃ dhāmacchaddvitīyā / agne bhūrīṇi tava jātavedas \\ iti dhāmacchat / agne devām̐ ihāvaha \ jajñāno vṛktabarhiṣe / \ asi hotā na īḍyaḥ / \ aganma mahā manasā yaviṣṭham \\ yo dīdāya samiddhaḥ sve duroṇe / \ citrabhānū rodasī antar urvī \ svāhutaṃ viśvataḥ pratyañcam // \ medhākāraṃ vidadhasya prasādhanam \ agniṃ hotāraṃ paribhūtamaṃ matim / \ tvām arbhasya haviṣaḥ samānam it \ tvāṃ maho vṛṇate naro nānyaṃ tvat / \ manuṣvat tvā nidhīmahi \ manuṣvat samidhīmahi / \ agne manuṣvad aṅgiras \\ devān devāyate yaja / \ agnir hi vājinaṃ viśe \ dadāti viśvacarṣaṇiḥ / \ agnī rāye svābhuvam \\ sa prīto yāti vāryam \ iṣam̐ stotṛbhya ābhara \\ ity etā āmnātā bhavanti //
11.8.23.a.d: आग्नेय्या गायत्रिया प्रथमां चितिम् अभिमृशेत् । त्रिष्टुभा द्वितीयाम् । जगत्या तृतीयाम् । अनुष्टुभा चतुर्थीम् । पङ्क्त्या पञ्चमीम् । सर्वासां धामच्छद्द्वितीया । अग्ने भूरीणि तव जातवेदस् \\ इति धामच्छत् । अग्ने देवाम्̐ इहावह \ जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे । \ असि होता न ईड्यः । \ अगन्म महा मनसा यविष्ठम् \\ यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे । \ चित्रभानू रोदसी अन्तर् उर्वी \ स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चम् ॥ \ मेधाकारं विदधस्य प्रसाधनम् \ अग्निं होतारं परिभूतमं मतिम् । \ त्वाम् अर्भस्य हविषः समानम् इत् \ त्वां महो वृणते नरो नान्यं त्वत् । \ मनुष्वत् त्वा निधीमहि \ मनुष्वत् समिधीमहि । \ अग्ने मनुष्वद् अङ्गिरस् \\ देवान् देवायते यज । \ अग्निर् हि वाजिनं विशे \ ददाति विश्वचर्षणिः । \ अग्नी राये स्वाभुवम् \\ स प्रीतो याति वार्यम् \ इषम्̐ स्तोतृभ्य आभर \\ इत्य् एता आम्नाता भवन्ति ॥
11.8.23.a.m: He should touch the first layer with a gāyatrī verse addressed to Agni; the second with a triṣṭubh; the third with a jagatī; the fourth with an anuṣṭubh; the fifth with a paṅkti. The dhāmacchad [verse] is the second for all of them. 'O Agni, many are thy [forms], O Jātavedas,' is the dhāmacchad. 'O Agni, bring the gods hither, / having been born, for him who has trimmed the sacred grass; / thou art our praiseworthy hotṛ,' 'We have approached the youngest with great mind, / who shines kindled in his own abode, / of wondrous splendor between the two wide worlds, / well-sacrificed, facing all directions,' 'Agni, the maker of wisdom, the accomplisher of sacrifice, / the hotṛ, the most encompassing thought; / thee alone, equal for a small oblation, / men choose for a great one, not any other than thee,' 'Like Manu we place thee, / like Manu we kindle thee; / O Agni, like Manu, O Aṅgiras, / sacrifice to the gods for him who seeks the gods,' [and] 'For Agni gives a prize-winner to the clan, / he who belongs to all peoples; / Agni [gives] one readily aiding towards wealth; / he, pleased, goes to what is desirable; / bring nourishment to the praisers'—these are the ones prescribed.

11.8.25.a.s: anupasadam agniṃ cinoti / anvaham ekaikā citir dvyaham uttamā citiḥ //
11.8.25.a.d: अनुपसदम् अग्निं चिनोति । अन्वहम् एकैका चितिर् द्व्यहम् उत्तमा चितिः ॥
11.8.25.a.m: He piles the fire [altar] following the Upasads. Each day there is one layer; the final layer lasts two days.

11.8.26.a.s: trīṇi catustanāni vratāni bhavanti / evaṃ tristanāni dvistanāny ekastanāni //
11.8.26.a.d: त्रीणि चतुस्तनानि व्रतानि भवन्ति । एवं त्रिस्तनानि द्विस्तनान्य् एकस्तनानि ॥
11.8.26.a.m: There are three observances [measured by the milk of] four teats; likewise [those of] three teats, two teats, and one teat.

11.8.27.a.s: āparāhṇikībhyāṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracarya yad akrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānas \\ iti śvetam aśvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariṇīya vasanti vasanti //
11.8.27.a.d: आपराह्णिकीभ्यां प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचर्य यद् अक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमानस् \\ इति श्वेतम् अश्वं प्रदक्षिणं परिणीय वसन्ति वसन्ति ॥
11.8.27.a.m: Having performed the afternoon Pravargya and Upasads, and having led a white horse around clockwise with 'When thou didst first whinny as thou wert born,' they dwell [there] each night.

12.1.1.a.s: sarvāsu citiṣu pravargyopasadāv āditaḥ paurvāhṇikyāv upariṣṭād āparāhṇikyau pravargyopasaccitihomo 'śvapariṇayanaṃ ca vyākhyātam / śvo bhūte dvitīyāṃ citiṃ cinoti //
12.1.1.a.d: सर्वासु चितिषु प्रवर्ग्योपसदाव् आदितः पौर्वाह्णिक्याव् उपरिष्टाद् आपराह्णिक्यौ प्रवर्ग्योपसच्चितिहोमो ऽश्वपरिणयनं च व्याख्यातम् । श्वो भूते द्वितीयां चितिं चिनोति ॥
12.1.1.a.m: In all layers, the Pravargya and Upasads are at the beginning in the morning, and the Pravargya and Upasads are later in the afternoon; the oblation upon the layer and the leading around of the horse have been explained. On the next day, he piles the second layer.

12.1.2.a.s: dhruvakṣitir dhruvayonir iti pañcāśvinīr upa dadhāti / catasraḥ pratidiśam ekāṃ madhye //
12.1.2.a.d: ध्रुवक्षितिर् ध्रुवयोनिर् इति पञ्चाश्विनीर् उप दधाति । चतस्रः प्रतिदिशम् एकां मध्ये ॥
12.1.2.a.m: With 'Firm dwelling, firm womb,' he places five Āśvinī bricks: four towards each direction and one in the middle.

12.1.3.a.s: sajūr ṛtubhir iti pañcartavyā āśvinīr upadadhāti //
12.1.3.a.d: सजूर् ऋतुभिर् इति पञ्चर्तव्या आश्विनीर् उपदधाति ॥
12.1.3.a.m: With 'In union with the seasons,' he places five Ṛtavyā bricks [after] the Āśvinī [bricks].

12.1.4.a.s: anuparihāram̐ sādayati prāṇaṃ me pāhi \\ apānaṃ me pāhi \\ iti pañca vāyavyā ṛtavyā anūpadadhāti vāyor yāny asi \ devānāṃ vāyo yāny asi \\ iti dve saṃyānye / śukraś ca śuciś ca \\ iti dve ṛtavye // samanatayā devate bhavataḥ //
12.1.4.a.d: अनुपरिहारम्̐ सादयति प्राणं मे पाहि \\ अपानं मे पाहि \\ इति पञ्च वायव्या ऋतव्या अनूपदधाति वायोर् यान्य् असि \ देवानां वायो यान्य् असि \\ इति द्वे संयान्ये । शुक्रश् च शुचिश् च \\ इति द्वे ऋतव्ये ॥ समनतया देवते भवतः ॥
12.1.4.a.m: He sets them down surrounding [the center]. With 'Protect my in-breath,' 'Protect my out-breath,' he places five Vāyavyā bricks after the Ṛtavyā bricks. 'Thou art the vehicle of Vāyu,' 'O Vāyu, thou art the vehicle of the gods' are the two Saṃyānī bricks. 'Śukra and Śuci' are two Ṛtavyā bricks. The two deities are in conformity.

12.1.5.a.s: apas pinva \\ iti pañcāpasyā vāyavyā anūpadadhāti / anuparihāram̐ sādayati / viṣṭambho vayas \\ iti catasraḥ / mūrdhanvatīḥ purastād upadadhāti //
12.1.5.a.d: अपस् पिन्व \\ इति पञ्चापस्या वायव्या अनूपदधाति । अनुपरिहारम्̐ सादयति । विष्टम्भो वयस् \\ इति चतस्रः । मूर्धन्वतीः पुरस्ताद् उपदधाति ॥
12.1.5.a.m: With 'Swell the waters,' he places five Apasyā bricks after the Vāyavyā bricks. He sets them down surrounding [the center]. With 'Support is the age,' [he places] four; he places the Mūrdhanvatī bricks in front.

12.1.6.a.s: tryavir vayas \\ iti pañca dakṣiṇato vayasvinīḥ / paṣṭhavād vayas \\ iti pañca paścād dve 'numatīr basto vayas \\ iti pañcottarataḥ sim̐havatīḥ / api vā basto vayas \\ iti dakṣiṇe 'm̐sa upadadhāti / vṛṣṇir vayas \\ ity uttare / vyāghro vayas \\ iti dakṣiṇe pakṣa upadadhāti / sim̐ho vayas \\ ity uttare / puruṣo vayas \\ iti madhye //
12.1.6.a.d: त्र्यविर् वयस् \\ इति पञ्च दक्षिणतो वयस्विनीः । पष्ठवाद् वयस् \\ इति पञ्च पश्चाद् द्वे ऽनुमतीर् बस्तो वयस् \\ इति पञ्चोत्तरतः सिम्̐हवतीः । अपि वा बस्तो वयस् \\ इति दक्षिणे ऽम्̐स उपदधाति । वृष्णिर् वयस् \\ इत्य् उत्तरे । व्याघ्रो वयस् \\ इति दक्षिणे पक्ष उपदधाति । सिम्̐हो वयस् \\ इत्य् उत्तरे । पुरुषो वयस् \\ इति मध्ये ॥
12.1.6.a.m: With 'A three-year-old steer is the age,' [he places] five Vayasvinī bricks on the south. With 'A four-year-old steer is the age,' [he places] five on the west, [and] two Anumatī bricks. With 'A goat is the age,' [he places] five Sim̐havatī bricks on the north. Alternatively, with 'A goat is the age,' he places [bricks] on the right shoulder; with 'A ram is the age,' on the left; with 'A tiger is the age,' he places [bricks] on the right wing; with 'A lion is the age,' on the left; with 'A man is the age,' in the middle.

12.1.7.a.m: The conclusion of the layer, beginning with the bull [gold chip], has been explained.

12.1.8.a.m: On the next day, he piles the third layer.

12.1.9.a.s: indrāgnī avyathamānām iti svayamātṛṇṇām abhimṛśyāśvenāvaghrāpya viśvakarmā tvā sādayatv antarikṣasya pṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīm iti madhye 'gner aviduṣā brāhmaṇena sahopadadhāti / bhuvas iti caitayā vyāhṛtyā //
12.1.9.a.d: इन्द्राग्नी अव्यथमानाम् इति स्वयमातृण्णाम् अभिमृश्याश्वेनावघ्राप्य विश्वकर्मा त्वा सादयत्व् अन्तरिक्षस्य पृष्ठे व्यचस्वतीम् इति मध्ये ऽग्नेर् अविदुषा ब्राह्मणेन सहोपदधाति । भुवस् इति चैतया व्याहृत्या ॥
12.1.9.a.m: Having touched the naturally perforated brick with "Indra and Agni, unshakeable…" and having caused a horse to sniff it, he lays it down in the center of the fire-altar together with an unlearned brahmin, with "May Viśvakarman set you on the back of the atmosphere, wide-extending!", and with this exclamation: "Bhuvas!"

12.1.10.a.s: cittiṃ juhomi \\ iti svayamātṛṇṇāyām̐ hutvānuvyanity avidvān brāhmaṇo varaṃ dadāti //
12.1.10.a.d: चित्तिं जुहोमि \\ इति स्वयमातृण्णायाम्̐ हुत्वानुव्यनित्य् अविद्वान् ब्राह्मणो वरं ददाति ॥
12.1.10.a.m: Having made an offering on the naturally perforated brick with "I offer thought…", [the adhvaryu] breathes along it, and gives a wish-boon to the unlearned brahmin.

12.1.11.a.s: jyotir asi \ jyotir me yaccha \\ antarikṣaṃ yaccha \\ antarikṣān mā pāhi \\ iti hiraṇyeṣṭakām / adhidyaur antarikṣaṃ brahmaṇā viṣṭā \ marutas te goptāras \\ iti maṇḍaleṣṭakām / anu retaḥsico vivayasa upadadhāti / viśvakarmā tvā sādayatv antarikṣasya pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm iti viśvajyotiṣam / antarikṣasya yāny asi \ devānām antarikṣa yāny asi \\ iti dve saṃyānyau //
12.1.11.a.d: ज्योतिर् असि \ ज्योतिर् मे यच्छ \\ अन्तरिक्षं यच्छ \\ अन्तरिक्षान् मा पाहि \\ इति हिरण्येष्टकाम् । अधिद्यौर् अन्तरिक्षं ब्रह्मणा विष्टा \ मरुतस् ते गोप्तारस् \\ इति मण्डलेष्टकाम् । अनु रेतःसिचो विवयस उपदधाति । विश्वकर्मा त्वा सादयत्व् अन्तरिक्षस्य पृष्ठे ज्योतिष्मतीम् इति विश्वज्योतिषम् । अन्तरिक्षस्य यान्य् असि \ देवानाम् अन्तरिक्ष यान्य् असि \\ इति द्वे संयान्यौ ॥
12.1.11.a.m: With "You are light, grant me light; grant the atmosphere, protect me from the atmosphere!" [he lays down] the gold brick; with "Over heaven is the atmosphere, entered by sacred prayer; the Maruts are your protectors" [he lays down] the disc brick; along the retaḥsic bricks he lays down the vivayas bricks; with "May Viśvakarman set you on the back of the atmosphere, full of light!" [he lays down] the viśvajyotis brick; with "You are the vehicle of the atmosphere" and "You are the vehicle of the gods in the atmosphere" [he lays down] the two saṃyānī bricks.

12.1.12.a.s: nabhaś ca nabhasyaś ceṣaś corjaś ceti catasra ṛtavyā dvedve samānatayā devate bhavataḥ //
12.1.12.a.d: नभश् च नभस्यश् चेषश् चोर्जश् चेति चतस्र ऋतव्या द्वेद्वे समानतया देवते भवतः ॥
12.1.12.a.m: With "Nabhas and Nabhasya, and Iṣa and Ūrja…" [he lays down] four seasonal bricks; two by two, they share a single deity.

12.1.13.a.s: rājñy asi prācī dik \\ iti pañca diśyāḥ / catasraḥ pratidiśam ekāṃ madhye //
12.1.13.a.d: राज्ञ्य् असि प्राची दिक् \\ इति पञ्च दिश्याः । चतस्रः प्रतिदिशम् एकां मध्ये ॥
12.1.13.a.m: With "You are the queen, the eastern direction…" [he lays down] the five directional bricks: four in each direction and one in the middle.

12.1.14.a.s: āyur me pāhi \\ iti daśa vairājīḥ purastād upadhāya //
12.1.14.a.d: आयुर् मे पाहि \\ इति दश वैराजीः पुरस्ताद् उपधाय ॥
12.1.14.a.m: Having laid ten vairājī bricks in the east with "Protect my lifetime!…",

12.1.15.a.s: ṣaṭtrim̐śataṃ bṛhatīr upadadhāti / mā chandas \\ iti dvādaśa dakṣiṇataḥ / pṛthivī chandas \\ iti dvādaśa paścāt / agnir devatā \\ iti dvādaśottarataḥ //
12.1.15.a.d: षट्त्रिम्̐शतं बृहतीर् उपदधाति । मा छन्दस् \\ इति द्वादश दक्षिणतः । पृथिवी छन्दस् \\ इति द्वादश पश्चात् । अग्निर् देवता \\ इति द्वादशोत्तरतः ॥
12.1.15.a.m: he lays down thirty-six bṛhatī bricks: twelve in the south with "Mā meter…", twelve in the west with "Pṛthivī meter…", and twelve in the north with "Agni the deity…".

12.1.16.a.s: mūrdhāsi rāṭ \\ iti sapta vālakhilyāḥ purastāt pratīcīr upadadhāti / yantrī rāṭ \\ iti sapta paścāt prācīḥ //
12.1.16.a.d: मूर्धासि राट् \\ इति सप्त वालखिल्याः पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीर् उपदधाति । यन्त्री राट् \\ इति सप्त पश्चात् प्राचीः ॥
12.1.16.a.m: With 'You are the head, the ruler,' he places seven Vālakhilyā bricks in the east facing west. With 'You are the controller, the ruler,' [he places] seven in the west facing east.

12.1.17.a.m: With 'Svāhā to the earth!' [he places] twelve Bhūta bricks.

12.1.18.a.s: prācyā tvā diśā sādayāmi \\ iti pañcātmeṣṭakāś catasraḥ pradiśam ekāṃ madhye //
12.1.18.a.d: प्राच्या त्वा दिशा सादयामि \\ इति पञ्चात्मेष्टकाश् चतस्रः प्रदिशम् एकां मध्ये ॥
12.1.18.a.m: With 'I seat you in the eastern quarter,' [he places] five Ātman bricks: four in each quarter, one in the middle.

12.1.19.a.s: indro dadhīco asthabhir ity etenānuvākenātharvāśiro daśātiṣaktā iṣṭakā upadadhāti //
12.1.19.a.d: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर् इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेनाथर्वाशिरो दशातिषक्ता इष्टका उपदधाति ॥
12.1.19.a.m: With the anuvāka 'Indra with the bones of Dadhīca…' he places the Atharvaśiras bricks, ten intertwined bricks.

12.1.20.a.m: The end of the layer, beginning with the bull, has been explained.

12.1.21.a.m: On the next day, he piles the fourth layer.

12.1.22.a.s: āśus trivṛt \\ agner bhāgo 'si \\ ity etābhyām anuvākābhyāṃ yathābrāhmaṇam upadadhāti //
12.1.22.a.d: आशुस् त्रिवृत् \\ अग्नेर् भागो ऽसि \\ इत्य् एताभ्याम् अनुवाकाभ्यां यथाब्राह्मणम् उपदधाति ॥
12.1.22.a.m: With these two anuvākas: 'The swift, the Trivṛt…' and 'You are Agni's share…', he places [the bricks] according to the Brāhmaṇa.

12.1.23.a.s: āśur aṣṭādaśādadhyād akṣṇayā stomasaṃyutāḥ / agneḥ śiṣṭā daśādadhyād akṣṇayā stomasaṃjñakāḥ //
12.1.23.a.d: आशुर् अष्टादशादध्याद् अक्ष्णया स्तोमसंयुताः । अग्नेः शिष्टा दशादध्याद् अक्ष्णया स्तोमसंज्ञकाः ॥
12.1.23.a.m: He should place eighteen [beginning with] 'The swift' diagonally, connected with the Stomas; he should place the remaining ten [beginning with] 'Agni's [share]' diagonally, designated as Stomas.

12.1.24.a.s: sahaś ca sahasyaś ca \\ iti dve ṛtavye / samānaṃ tayādevate bhavataḥ //
12.1.24.a.d: सहश् च सहस्यश् च \\ इति द्वे ऋतव्ये । समानं तयादेवते भवतः ॥
12.1.24.a.m: With 'Sahas and Sahasya,' [he places] two seasonal bricks. The Tayādevatā formulas are the same [as before].

12.1.25.a.m: With 'They praised with one…' [he places] seventeen Sṛṣṭi bricks.

12.1.26.a.s: iyam eva sā yā prathamā vyaucchat \\ iti pañcadaśa vyuṣṭīḥ //
12.1.26.a.d: इयम् एव सा या प्रथमा व्यौच्छत् \\ इति पञ्चदश व्युष्टीः ॥
12.1.26.a.m: With 'This indeed is she who first shone forth…' [he places] fifteen Vyuṣṭi bricks.

12.1.27.a.s: agne jātān pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān iti purastād upadadhāti / sahasā jātān iti paścāt / catuścatvārim̐śaḥ stomas \\ iti dakṣiṇataḥ / ṣoḍaśaḥ stomas \\ ity uttarataḥ //
12.1.27.a.d: अग्ने जातान् प्र णुदा नः सपत्नान् इति पुरस्ताद् उपदधाति । सहसा जातान् इति पश्चात् । चतुश्चत्वारिम्̐शः स्तोमस् \\ इति दक्षिणतः । षोडशः स्तोमस् \\ इत्य् उत्तरतः ॥
12.1.27.a.m: With 'O Agni, repel our rivals who are born,' he places [bricks] in the east; with 'Forcefully those born…' in the west; with 'The forty-fourfold Stoma…' in the south; with 'The sixteenfold Stoma…' in the north.

12.1.28.a.s: iṣṭakāyāṃ purīṣam adhyūhya pṛthivyāḥ purīṣam asy apso nāma \\ iti madhye 'gneḥ purīṣavatīm upadadhāti //
12.1.28.a.d: इष्टकायां पुरीषम् अध्यूह्य पृथिव्याः पुरीषम् अस्य् अप्सो नाम \\ इति मध्ये ऽग्नेः पुरीषवतीम् उपदधाति ॥
12.1.28.a.m: Having heaped loose earth upon a brick, he places the loose-earth-bearing brick in the middle of the fire altar with 'You are the loose earth of the earth, waters by name…'

12.1.29.a.m: The end of the layer, beginning with the bull, has been explained.

12.1.30.a.s: śvo bhūte paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pracarya pañcamīṃ citiṃ cinoti //
12.1.30.a.d: श्वो भूते पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रचर्य पञ्चमीं चितिं चिनोति ॥
12.1.30.a.m: On the next day, having performed the two morning rites, he piles the fifth layer.

12.1.31.a.s: evaś chandas \\ varivaś chandas \\ iti catvārim̐śataṃ virājo daśadaśa pratidiśam akṣṇayā //
12.1.31.a.d: एवश् छन्दस् \\ वरिवश् छन्दस् \\ इति चत्वारिम्̐शतं विराजो दशदश प्रतिदिशम् अक्ष्णया ॥
12.1.31.a.m: With 'Eva is the meter,' 'Varivas is the meter,' [he places] forty Virāj bricks, ten in each direction diagonally.

12.1.32.a.s: raśmir asi \ kṣayāya tvā \ kṣayaṃ jinva \\ ity ekatrim̐śatam̐ stomabhāgāḥ saptasapta pratidiśaṃ tisro madhye //
12.1.32.a.d: रश्मिर् असि \ क्षयाय त्वा \ क्षयं जिन्व \\ इत्य् एकत्रिम्̐शतम्̐ स्तोमभागाः सप्तसप्त प्रतिदिशं तिस्रो मध्ये ॥
12.1.32.a.m: With 'You are the ray; for dwelling [I seat] you; quicken the dwelling,' [he places] thirty-one Stomabhāga bricks, seven in each direction and three in the middle.

12.1.33.a.s: rājñy asi prācī diś \\ iti pañca nākasadaś catasraḥ pratidiśam ekāṃ madhye / paścāt prācīm uttamām upadhāya \\ ayaṃ puro harikeśas \\ iti nākasatsu pañca coḍā upadadhāti / tā upadhāya vṛttāṃ citiṃ cinoti //
12.1.33.a.d: राज्ञ्य् असि प्राची दिश् \\ इति पञ्च नाकसदश् चतस्रः प्रतिदिशम् एकां मध्ये । पश्चात् प्राचीम् उत्तमाम् उपधाय \\ अयं पुरो हरिकेशस् \\ इति नाकसत्सु पञ्च चोडा उपदधाति । ता उपधाय वृत्तां चितिं चिनोति ॥
12.1.33.a.m: With 'You are the queen, the eastern quarter,' [he places] five Nākasad bricks, four in each direction and one in the middle; having placed the last one in the west facing east, he places five Cūḍā bricks upon the Nākasad bricks with 'This one in front, the golden-haired…'; having placed them, he piles the circular layer.

12.1.34.a.s: tapaś ca tapasyaś ca \\ iti dve ṛtavye samānatayādevate bhavataḥ //
12.1.34.a.d: तपश् च तपस्यश् च \\ इति द्वे ऋतव्ये समानतयादेवते भवतः ॥
12.1.34.a.m: With 'Tapas and Tapasya,' [he places] two seasonal bricks. The Tayādevatā formulas are the same [as before].

12.1.35.a.s: devānāṃ yāny asi \ devānāṃ devayāny asi \\ iti dve saṃyānyau //
12.1.35.a.d: देवानां यान्य् असि \ देवानां देवयान्य् असि \\ इति द्वे संयान्यौ ॥
12.1.35.a.m: With 'You are the path of the gods,' 'You are the way to the gods of the gods,' [he places] two Saṃyānī bricks.

12.1.36.a.s: prajāpatis tvā sādayatu divaḥ pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm iti viśvajyotiṣam / atra retaḥsicaḥ sthavirasyopadadhāti //
12.1.36.a.d: प्रजापतिस् त्वा सादयतु दिवः पृष्ठे ज्योतिष्मतीम् इति विश्वज्योतिषम् । अत्र रेतःसिचः स्थविरस्योपदधाति ॥
12.1.36.a.m: With 'May Prajāpati seat you on the back of heaven, full of light,' [he places] the Viśvajyotiṣ brick. Here he places the seed-pourers of the elder.

12.1.37.a.s: dyaur aparājitāmṛtena viṣṭā \\ ādityās te goptāras \\ iti maṇḍaleṣṭakām / suvar asi \ suvar me yaccha \ divaṃ yaccha \ divo mā pāhi \\ iti hiraṇyeṣṭakām //
12.1.37.a.d: द्यौर् अपराजितामृतेन विष्टा \\ आदित्यास् ते गोप्तारस् \\ इति मण्डलेष्टकाम् । सुवर् असि \ सुवर् मे यच्छ \ दिवं यच्छ \ दिवो मा पाहि \\ इति हिरण्येष्टकाम् ॥
12.1.37.a.m: With 'Heaven, unconquered, entered by the nectar; the Ādityas are your protectors,' [he places] the disc brick. With 'You are heaven; grant me heaven; grant the sky; protect me from the sky,' [he places] the gold brick.

12.1.38.a.s: āparāhṇikībhyāṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracarya yad akrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānas \\ iti śvetam aśvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariṇīya vasanti //
12.1.38.a.d: आपराह्णिकीभ्यां प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचर्य यद् अक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमानस् \\ इति श्वेतम् अश्वं प्रदक्षिणं परिणीय वसन्ति ॥
12.1.38.a.m: Having performed the two afternoon Pravargya and Upasad rites, having led a white horse around clockwise with 'When first crying out as you were born…', they dwell [for the night].

12.1.39.a.s: audumbarīs tisraḥ samidhaḥ prādeśamātrīr ghṛte vāsayati //
12.1.39.a.d: औदुम्बरीस् तिस्रः समिधः प्रादेशमात्रीर् घृते वासयति ॥
12.1.39.a.m: He steeps three kindling sticks of udumbara wood, a span in length, in clarified butter.

12.1.40.a.s: śvo bhūta uttamābhyāṃ paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracarya pañcamyāś citeḥ śeṣaṃ yājñasenīṃ citiṃ cinoti //
12.1.40.a.d: श्वो भूत उत्तमाभ्यां पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचर्य पञ्चम्याश् चितेः शेषं याज्ञसेनीं चितिं चिनोति ॥
12.1.40.a.m: On the next day, having performed the two final morning Pravargya and Upasad rites, he piles the remainder of the fifth layer, the Yājñasenī layer.

12.1.41.a.s: agnir mūrdhā \\ iti tisro gāyatrīr mūrdhanvatīḥ purastād upadadhāti / uttaratas triṣṭubhas tisro dakṣiṇā uttarā jagatīs tisraḥ paścād uttarā anuṣṭubhas tisra uttarato bṛhatīr uṣṇihāḥ paṅktīr akṣarapaṅktīr iti viṣurūpāṇi cchandām̐si yathāvakāśam upadadhāti //
12.1.41.a.d: अग्निर् मूर्धा \\ इति तिस्रो गायत्रीर् मूर्धन्वतीः पुरस्ताद् उपदधाति । उत्तरतस् त्रिष्टुभस् तिस्रो दक्षिणा उत्तरा जगतीस् तिस्रः पश्चाद् उत्तरा अनुष्टुभस् तिस्र उत्तरतो बृहतीर् उष्णिहाः पङ्क्तीर् अक्षरपङ्क्तीर् इति विषुरूपाणि च्छन्दाम्̐सि यथावकाशम् उपदधाति ॥
12.1.41.a.m: With 'Agni is the head,' he places three Gāyatrī verses containing 'head' in the east; northward three Triṣṭubh verses; southward and northward three Jagatī verses; westward and northward three Anuṣṭubh verses; northward the Bṛhatī, Uṣṇih, Paṅkti, and Akṣarapaṅkti verses—in this way he places the diverse meters according to space.

12.1.42.a.m: Right here he places the Atichandas brick; having placed the Dvipadā brick as the last,

12.1.43.a.s: āyos tvā sadane sādayāmi \\ iti svayamātṛṇṇām abhimṛśyāśvenāvaghrāpya parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu divaḥ pṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīm iti madhye 'gner aviduṣā brāhmaṇena sahopadadhāti / suvar ity etayā vyāhṛtyā /
12.1.43.a.d: आयोस् त्वा सदने सादयामि \\ इति स्वयमातृण्णाम् अभिमृश्याश्वेनावघ्राप्य परमेष्ठी त्वा सादयतु दिवः पृष्ठे व्यचस्वतीम् इति मध्ये ऽग्नेर् अविदुषा ब्राह्मणेन सहोपदधाति । सुवर् इत्य् एतया व्याहृत्या ।
12.1.43.a.m: having touched the naturally perforated brick with 'I seat you in the seat of Āyu,' and caused it to be sniffed by the horse, he places it in the middle of the fire altar together with an unlearned brāhmaṇa, with 'May Parameṣṭhin seat you on the back of heaven, wide-extended,' [and] with this exclamation: 'Suvar!'

12.1.44.a.s: citiṃ juhomi \\ iti svayamātṛṇṇāyām̐ hutvāpāniti / prothad aśvo na yavase aviṣyan \\ ity uttare 'm̐se vikarṇīm upadadhāti / svayamātṛṇṇāṃ ca vikarṇīṃ ca nānyābhir iṣṭakābhir abhyupadadhāti //
12.1.44.a.d: चितिं जुहोमि \\ इति स्वयमातृण्णायाम्̐ हुत्वापानिति । प्रोथद् अश्वो न यवसे अविष्यन् \\ इत्य् उत्तरे ऽम्̐से विकर्णीम् उपदधाति । स्वयमातृण्णां च विकर्णीं च नान्याभिर् इष्टकाभिर् अभ्युपदधाति ॥
12.1.44.a.m: Having offered into the naturally perforated brick with 'I sacrifice the layer,' he breathes out. With 'Like a horse snorting when desirous of pasture,' he places the Vikarṇī brick on the northern shoulder. He does not place [other] bricks over the naturally perforated brick or the Vikarṇī brick.

12.1.45.a.s: agne gobhir na āgahi \\ ity etenānuvākena gocitim upadadhāti / sahasraṃ pādamātrīr iṣṭakāḥ //
12.1.45.a.d: अग्ने गोभिर् न आगहि \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन गोचितिम् उपदधाति । सहस्रं पादमात्रीर् इष्टकाः ॥
12.1.45.a.m: With the anuvāka 'O Agni, come to us with cows…' he places the cow-layer: a thousand bricks measuring a foot.

12.1.46.a.s: tā madhyamāyāṃ cityāṃ cityāṃ paśukāma upadadhāti //
12.1.46.a.d: ता मध्यमायां चित्यां चित्यां पशुकाम उपदधाति ॥
12.1.46.a.m: One who desires cattle places them in layer after layer, in the middle layer.

12.2.1.a.s: indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā sayujā yujā yunajmi \\ ity aṣṭau sayujaḥ //
12.2.1.a.d: इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा सयुजा युजा युनज्मि \\ इत्य् अष्टौ सयुजः ॥
12.2.1.a.m: With 'I yoke you with Indra and Agni as yoked companions,' [he places] eight Sayuj bricks.

12.2.2.a.m: With 'You are Ambā by name…' [he places] seven Kṛttikā bricks.

12.2.3.a.s: purovātasanir asi \\ iti pañca vṛṣṭisanīr anuparihāram̐ sādayati //
12.2.3.a.d: पुरोवातसनिर् असि \\ इति पञ्च वृष्टिसनीर् अनुपरिहारम्̐ सादयति ॥
12.2.3.a.m: With 'You are the winner of the east wind…' he sets down five rain-winning bricks in clockwise succession.

12.2.4.a.s: salilāya tvā \ sarṇīkāya tvā \\ ity aṣṭāv ādityeṣṭakāḥ //
12.2.4.a.d: सलिलाय त्वा \ सर्णीकाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अष्टाव् आदित्येष्टकाः ॥
12.2.4.a.m: With 'For the surge [I seat] you,' 'For the flood [I seat] you,' [he places] eight Āditya bricks.

12.2.5.a.s: ṛce tvā \ ruce tvā \\ iti pañca ghṛteṣṭakā anuparihāram̐ sādayati //
12.2.5.a.d: ऋचे त्वा \ रुचे त्वा \\ इति पञ्च घृतेष्टका अनुपरिहारम्̐ सादयति ॥
12.2.5.a.m: With 'For the verse [I seat] you,' 'For the light [I seat] you,' he sets down five clarified-butter bricks in clockwise succession.

12.2.6.a.s: yaśodāṃ tvā yaśasi sādayāmi \\ iti pañca yaśodāḥ //
12.2.6.a.d: यशोदां त्वा यशसि सादयामि \\ इति पञ्च यशोदाः ॥
12.2.6.a.m: With 'I seat you, the fame-bestowing, in fame,' [he places] five fame-bestowing bricks.

12.2.7.a.s: bhūyaskṛd asi \ varivaskṛd asi \\ iti pañca bhūyaskṛtaḥ //
12.2.7.a.d: भूयस्कृद् असि \ वरिवस्कृद् असि \\ इति पञ्च भूयस्कृतः ॥
12.2.7.a.m: With 'You are the maker of increase,' 'You are the maker of wide space,' [he places] five maker-of-increase bricks.

12.2.8.a.s: apsuṣad asi \ śyenasad asi \\ iti pañcāgnirūpāṇi //
12.2.8.a.d: अप्सुषद् असि \ श्येनसद् असि \\ इति पञ्चाग्निरूपाणि ॥
12.2.8.a.m: With 'You are sitting in the waters,' 'You are sitting like a hawk,' [he places] five forms of Agni.

12.2.9.a.s: pṛthivyās tvā draviṇe sādayāmi \\ iti pañca draviṇodāḥ //
12.2.9.a.d: पृथिव्यास् त्वा द्रविणे सादयामि \\ इति पञ्च द्रविणोदाः ॥
12.2.9.a.m: With 'I seat you in the wealth of the earth,' [he places] five wealth-bestowing bricks.

12.2.10.a.s: prāṇaṃ me pāhi \\ apānaṃ me pāhi \\ iti ṣaḍ āyuṣyāḥ //
12.2.10.a.d: प्राणं मे पाहि \\ अपानं मे पाहि \\ इति षड् आयुष्याः ॥
12.2.10.a.m: With 'Protect my out-breath,' 'Protect my in-breath,' [he places] six life-prolonging bricks.

12.2.11.a.s: agne yat te param̐ hṛn nāma \\ ity agner hṛdayam //
12.2.11.a.d: अग्ने यत् ते परम्̐ हृन् नाम \\ इत्य् अग्नेर् हृदयम् ॥
12.2.11.a.m: With 'O Agni, what is your supreme heart by name…' [he places] the heart of Agni.

12.2.12.a.m: With 'The uniting, the non-uniting…' [he places] seven seasonal bricks.

12.2.13.a.m: With the anuvāka 'All-conquering through Agni…' he places the Indra's body bricks.

12.2.14.a.s: abhīṣāc cābhiṣavī ca \\ abhivayāś cordhvavayāś ca \ bṛhadvayāś ca savayāś ca \ sahvām̐ś ca sahamānaś ca \ sahasvām̐ś ca sahīyām̐ś ca \\ ity etenānuvākenendranāmāny upadadhāti //
12.2.14.a.d: अभीषाच् चाभिषवी च \\ अभिवयाश् चोर्ध्ववयाश् च \ बृहद्वयाश् च सवयाश् च \ सह्वाम्̐श् च सहमानश् च \ सहस्वाम्̐श् च सहीयाम्̐श् च \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेनेन्द्रनामान्य् उपदधाति ॥
12.2.14.a.m: With the anuvāka 'The overpowering and the presser, the vigorous and the upward-vigorous, the great-vigorous and the co-vigorous, the prevailing and the patient, the mighty and the mightier,' he places the names of Indra.

12.2.15.a.d: प्रजापतिर् मनसाश्वो ऽच्छेतस् \\ इति त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शतं यज्ञतनूः ॥
12.2.15.a.m: With 'Prajāpati by mind, a horse…' [he places] thirty-three sacrifice-body bricks.

12.2.16.a.s: jyotiṣmatīṃ tvā sādayāmi \\ iti dvādaśa jyotiṣmatīḥ //
12.2.16.a.d: ज्योतिष्मतीं त्वा सादयामि \\ इति द्वादश ज्योतिष्मतीः ॥
12.2.16.a.m: With 'I seat you, luminous…' [he places] twelve luminous bricks.

12.2.17.a.s: rohiteṣu tvā jīmūteṣu sādayāmi / \ aruṇeṣu tvā jīmūteṣu sādayāmi / \ siteṣu tvā jīmūteṣu sādayāmi / \ nīleṣu tvā jīmūteṣu sādayāmi / \ kṛṣṇeṣu tvā jīmūteṣu sādayāmi \\ iti pañca jīmūtāḥ //
12.2.17.a.d: रोहितेषु त्वा जीमूतेषु सादयामि । \ अरुणेषु त्वा जीमूतेषु सादयामि । \ सितेषु त्वा जीमूतेषु सादयामि । \ नीलेषु त्वा जीमूतेषु सादयामि । \ कृष्णेषु त्वा जीमूतेषु सादयामि \\ इति पञ्च जीमूताः ॥
12.2.17.a.m: With 'I seat you in the red clouds,' 'I seat you in the ruddy clouds,' 'I seat you in the white clouds,' 'I seat you in the blue clouds,' 'I seat you in the black clouds,' [he places] five cloud bricks.

12.2.18.a.s: kṛttikā nakṣatram ity etenānuvākenāsam̐spaṣṭā nakṣatreṣṭakā upadadhāti //
12.2.18.a.d: कृत्तिका नक्षत्रम् इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेनासम्̐स्पष्टा नक्षत्रेष्टका उपदधाति ॥
12.2.18.a.m: With the anuvāka 'The Kṛttikās are the asterism…' he places the asterism bricks without touching [one another].

12.2.19.a.s: agne rucaḥ stha \\ iti sarvāsv anuṣajati //
12.2.19.a.d: अग्ने रुचः स्थ \\ इति सर्वास्व् अनुषजति ॥
12.2.19.a.m: He attaches [the formula] 'You are the lights of Agni' to all of them.

12.2.20.a.s: pūrṇā paścāt \\ iti purastāt paurṇamāsīm upadhāya pūrvāṃpūrvām upadhāyāparāmaparām upadadhāti / ā viśākhābhyām / yat te devā adadhur iti paścād amāvāsyāyām upadhāyāparāmaparām upadhāya pūrvāṃpūrvām upadadhāty āpabharaṇībhyo 'ntataḥ //
12.2.20.a.d: पूर्णा पश्चात् \\ इति पुरस्तात् पौर्णमासीम् उपधाय पूर्वांपूर्वाम् उपधायापरामपराम् उपदधाति । आ विशाखाभ्याम् । यत् ते देवा अदधुर् इति पश्चाद् अमावास्यायाम् उपधायापरामपराम् उपधाय पूर्वांपूर्वाम् उपदधात्य् आपभरणीभ्यो ऽन्ततः ॥
12.2.20.a.m: With the mantra, 'Full behind,' having placed the Full Moon brick in the east, placing each previous one he places each subsequent one up to the Viśākhās. With the mantra, 'What the gods placed for you,' having placed the New Moon brick in the west, placing each subsequent one he places each previous one up to the Apabharaṇīs at the end.

12.2.21.a.m: With 'In the beginning, Hiraṇyagarbha came into being,' [he places] eight stream [bricks].

12.2.22.a.s: viśvakarmā diśāṃ patir iti pañca hiraṇyeṣṭakāś catasraḥ pratidiśam ekāṃ madhye //
12.2.22.a.d: विश्वकर्मा दिशां पतिर् इति पञ्च हिरण्येष्टकाश् चतस्रः प्रतिदिशम् एकां मध्ये ॥
12.2.22.a.m: With 'Viśvakarman is the lord of the quarters,' [he places] five golden bricks: four in each quarter, one in the middle.

12.2.23.a.s: prāṇāya tvā cakṣuṣe tvā \\ iti catasraḥ śarkarāḥ svayamātṛṇṇāḥ pratidiśam / [ saṃvatsarasya pratimām iti pratimām atraivarṣabha āmnātaḥ ] //
12.2.23.a.d: प्राणाय त्वा चक्षुषे त्वा \\ इति चतस्रः शर्कराः स्वयमातृण्णाः प्रतिदिशम् । [ संवत्सरस्य प्रतिमाम् इति प्रतिमाम् अत्रैवर्षभ आम्नातः ] ॥
12.2.23.a.m: With 'To breath [I place] thee, to sight [I place] thee,' [he places] four self-perforated pebble [bricks] in each quarter. [With 'The image of the year,' the bull [formula] is handed down right here as the image.]

12.2.24.a.s: agna āyāhi vītaye / \ agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe / \ agnināgniḥ samidhyate / \ agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanat / \ agne stomaṃ manāmahe \ sidhram adya divispṛśam / \ devasya draviṇasyavas \\ iti pañcāhnāṃ rūpāṇi / [ atha vratam upadadhāti ] //
12.2.24.a.d: अग्न आयाहि वीतये । \ अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे । \ अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते । \ अग्निर् वृत्राणि जङ्घनत् । \ अग्ने स्तोमं मनामहे \ सिध्रम् अद्य दिविस्पृशम् । \ देवस्य द्रविणस्यवस् \\ इति पञ्चाह्नां रूपाणि । [ अथ व्रतम् उपदधाति ] ॥
12.2.24.a.m: 'Come, Agni, to the feast,' / 'Agni the messenger we choose,' / 'By Agni is Agni kindled,' / 'May Agni strike the foes,' / 'We ponder a praise-song for Agni, / effective today, touching the sky,' / 'Desiring wealth of the god'—these are the forms of the five days. [Then he places the vrata brick.]

12.2.25.a.s: śatāyudhāya \\ iti pañcājyānīḥ / indrasya vajro 'si vārtraghnas \\ iti catasro vajriṇīḥ pratidiśaṃ ( aśmana iṣuhasta upadadhāti ) pañcaike samāmananti yo na upariṣṭāt \\ iti mantram̐ saṃnamati //
12.2.25.a.d: शतायुधाय \\ इति पञ्चाज्यानीः । इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसि वार्त्रघ्नस् \\ इति चतस्रो वज्रिणीः प्रतिदिशं ( अश्मन इषुहस्त उपदधाति ) पञ्चैके समामनन्ति यो न उपरिष्टात् \\ इति मन्त्रम्̐ संनमति ॥
12.2.25.a.m: With 'To the hundred-weaponed one,' [he places] five Ājyānī [bricks]. With 'Thou art Indra's thunderbolt, slayer of Vṛtra,' [he places] four Vajriṇī [bricks] in each quarter (with arrow in hand, he places the stone bricks). Some hand down five: he adapts the mantra, 'He who from above us...'

12.2.26.a.s: agne yaśasvin yaśasemam arpaya \\ iti catasro rāṣṭrabhṛtaḥ / gāyatrīṃ purastād upadadhāti triṣṭubhaṃ dakṣiṇato jagatīṃ paścād anuṣṭubham uttarataḥ paṅktiṃ madhye / gāyatrīṃ dakṣiṇata upadadhāti / evam anupūrvāḥ sarvāḥ / sarvatra \\ agnir mūrdhā / \ bhuvo / \ janasya gopāḥ / \ tvāṃ citraśravastama / \ agne tam adyāśvam ity etā āmnātā bhavanti //
12.2.26.a.d: अग्ने यशस्विन् यशसेमम् अर्पय \\ इति चतस्रो राष्ट्रभृतः । गायत्रीं पुरस्ताद् उपदधाति त्रिष्टुभं दक्षिणतो जगतीं पश्चाद् अनुष्टुभम् उत्तरतः पङ्क्तिं मध्ये । गायत्रीं दक्षिणत उपदधाति । एवम् अनुपूर्वाः सर्वाः । सर्वत्र \\ अग्निर् मूर्धा । \ भुवो । \ जनस्य गोपाः । \ त्वां चित्रश्रवस्तम । \ अग्ने तम् अद्याश्वम् इत्य् एता आम्नाता भवन्ति ॥
12.2.26.a.m: With 'O renowned Agni, confer glory upon this man,' [he places] four Rāṣṭrabhṛt [bricks]. He places a Gāyatrī [brick] in the east, a Triṣṭubh in the south, a Jagatī in the west, an Anuṣṭubh in the north, and a Paṅkti in the middle. He places a Gāyatrī in the south. In this order [are] all [the bricks]. Everywhere, these are handed down: 'Agni is head,' 'Thou becamest,' 'Guardian of the people,' 'To thee, most wonderfully famed,' 'Agni, today that horse.'
