13.1.61.a.d: वाजिनो वाजजितो वाजम्̐ ससृवाम्̐सस् \\ इति नैवारम् अश्वयुग्याव् अवघ्रापयति । यथापुरस्तात् प्रप्रोथेषु च लेपान् निमार्ष्टि ॥
13.1.61.a.m: He makes the two yoked horses smell the wild-rice mess with [the mantra,] 'Prize-winning coursers, having run for the prize...'; and, as before, he wipes off the residues on their muzzles.

13.1.62.a.m: He gives a kṛṣṇala [gold piece] to each of the chariot-runners.

13.1.63.a.m: Taking them back, he gives them to the brahman.

13.1.64.a.m: And the wheel-cap [or top-piece] made of honey [or mead] and worth a hundred measures.

13.2.1.a.s: kṣattrasyolban asi \\ iti tārpyaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte / kṣattrasya yonir asi \\ iti darbhamayaṃ patnī //
13.2.1.a.d: क्षत्त्रस्योल्बन् असि \\ इति तार्प्यं यजमानः परिधत्ते । क्षत्त्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति दर्भमयं पत्नी ॥
13.2.1.a.m: The sacrificer puts on a tārpya garment with [the mantra,] 'You are the womb of dominion'; the sacrificer's wife puts on a garment made of darbha grass with [the mantra,] 'You are the source of dominion.'

13.2.2.a.s: jāya ehi suvo rohāva \\ iti patnīṃ yajamāna āmantrayate / rohāva hi \\ iti patnī pratyāha //
13.2.2.a.d: जाय एहि सुवो रोहाव \\ इति पत्नीं यजमान आमन्त्रयते । रोहाव हि \\ इति पत्नी प्रत्याह ॥
13.2.2.a.m: The sacrificer invites his wife: 'Wife, come, let us ascend to heaven!' The wife responds: 'Let us indeed ascend.'

13.2.3.a.s: ahaṃ nāv ubhayoḥ suvo rokṣyāmi \\ iti yajamānas tvaṃ nāv ubhyoḥ suvo roha \\ iti patnī //
13.2.3.a.d: अहं नाव् उभयोः सुवो रोक्ष्यामि \\ इति यजमानस् त्वं नाव् उभ्योः सुवो रोह \\ इति पत्नी ॥
13.2.3.a.m: The sacrificer says, 'I shall ascend to heaven for both of us'; the wife says, 'Ascend to heaven for both of us.'

13.2.4.a.s: āyuryajñena kalpatām iti daśabhiḥ kalpaiḥ sarajasi niḥśreṇyā yūpam ārohati / ubhau vā //
13.2.4.a.d: आयुर्यज्ञेन कल्पताम् इति दशभिः कल्पैः सरजसि निःश्रेण्या यूपम् आरोहति । उभौ वा ॥
13.2.4.a.m: With the ten kalpa mantras [beginning,] 'May life-breath succeed through sacrifice,' he ascends the sacrificial post by a ladder while holding [a bag of] salt-soil; or both of them [ascend].

13.2.5.a.s: suvar devām̐ aganma \\ ity āruhya japati //
13.2.5.a.d: सुवर् देवाम्̐ अगन्म \\ इत्य् आरुह्य जपति ॥
13.2.5.a.m: Having ascended, he mutters, 'We have gone to heaven, to the gods.'

13.2.6.a.s: vājaś ca prasavaś ca \\ iti dvādaśāhutīr juhoti //
13.2.6.a.d: वाजश् च प्रसवश् च \\ इति द्वादशाहुतीर् जुहोति ॥
13.2.6.a.m: He offers twelve oblations with [the mantras beginning,] 'Both prize and impulse...'

13.2.8.a.m: Some teach [that this offering takes place] before ascending the sacrificial post.

13.2.9.a.s: sam aham āyuṣā saṃ mayāyuḥ \ sam ahaṃ varcasā saṃ mayā varcaḥ \ sam ahaṃ prajayā saṃ mayā prajā \ sam aham̐ rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ mayā rāyaspoṣas \\ iti yūpam āruhya grahān pratyavekṣate //
13.2.9.a.d: सम् अहम् आयुषा सं मयायुः \ सम् अहं वर्चसा सं मया वर्चः \ सम् अहं प्रजया सं मया प्रजा \ सम् अहम्̐ रायस्पोषेण सं मया रायस्पोषस् \\ इति यूपम् आरुह्य ग्रहान् प्रत्यवेक्षते ॥
13.2.9.a.m: Having mounted the sacrificial post, he looks down at the cups with [the mantras,] 'May I be united with life, may life be united with me; may I be united with vigor, may vigor be united with me; may I be united with offspring, may offspring be united with me; may I be united with the increase of wealth, may the increase of wealth be united with me.'

13.2.10.a.s: tam āśvatthair ūṣapuṭair dīrghavam̐śaprabaddhair āsyato mahartvijaḥ pratidiśam̐ samarpayanti / śīrṣata ity ekeṣām / āsapuṭair vaiśvam annāya tvā \\ iti purastād adhvaryuḥ / annādyāya tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇato brahmā / vājāya tvā \\ iti paścād dhotā / vājajityāyai tvā \\ ity uttarata udgātā //
13.2.10.a.d: तम् आश्वत्थैर् ऊषपुटैर् दीर्घवम्̐शप्रबद्धैर् आस्यतो महर्त्विजः प्रतिदिशम्̐ समर्पयन्ति । शीर्षत इत्य् एकेषाम् । आसपुटैर् वैश्वम् अन्नाय त्वा \\ इति पुरस्ताद् अध्वर्युः । अन्नाद्याय त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा । वाजाय त्वा \\ इति पश्चाद् धोता । वाजजित्यायै त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरत उद्गाता ॥
13.2.10.a.m: The principal priests, using bags of salt-soil made of aśvattha leaves tied to long bamboo poles, throw them at him up to his mouth from each direction; according to some, up to his head; or [they use] mouth-bags made of all kinds [of material]: the adhvaryu from the east with 'For food, thee!'; the brahman from the south with 'For the eating of food, thee!'; the hotṛ from the west with 'For the prize, thee!'; the udgātṛ from the north with 'For winning the prize, thee!'

13.2.11.a.m: Stretching out both arms, he turns toward the smiter.

13.2.12.a.s: iyaṃ te rāṇ mitrāya yantrāsi yamanas \\ dhartāsi dharuṇaḥ \ kṛṣyai kṣemāya rayyai poṣāya \\ iti pratyavarohati //
13.2.12.a.d: इयं ते राण् मित्राय यन्त्रासि यमनस् \\ धर्तासि धरुणः \ कृष्यै क्षेमाय रय्यै पोषाय \\ इति प्रत्यवरोहति ॥
13.2.12.a.m: He climbs down with [the mantra,] 'This is your kingdom. A supporter are you for Mitra, a restrainer, a holder, a support; for agriculture, for well-being, for wealth, for prosperity.'

13.2.13.a.m: In front of the sacrificial post, he spreads out a he-goat skin with the neck to the east and the hairy side facing upward.

13.2.14.a.s: tejo 'si \\ iti tasmin rājatam̐ rukmaṃ nidadhāti //
13.2.14.a.d: तेजो ऽसि \\ इति तस्मिन् राजतम्̐ रुक्मं निदधाति ॥
13.2.14.a.m: On it he places a silver plate with [the mantra,] 'You are brilliance.'

13.2.15.a.s: amṛtam asi \\ iti rukme pādaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayate //
13.2.15.a.d: अमृतम् असि \\ इति रुक्मे पादं प्रतिष्ठापयते ॥
13.2.15.a.m: He places his foot upon the plate with [the mantra,] 'You are immortality.'

13.2.16.a.s: puṣṭir asi \ prajananam asi \\ iti bastājine //
13.2.16.a.d: पुष्टिर् असि \ प्रजननम् असि \\ इति बस्ताजिने ॥
13.2.16.a.m: He places [the other foot] upon the he-goat skin with [the mantra,] 'You are nourishment; you are procreation.'

13.2.17.a.m: From there he ascends the throne-chair.

13.2.18.a.s: divaṃ proṣṭhinīm āroha tām āruhya prapaśyaikarāṇ manuṣyāṇām edhi \\ ity ārohantam abhimantrayate //
13.2.18.a.d: दिवं प्रोष्ठिनीम् आरोह ताम् आरुह्य प्रपश्यैकराण् मनुष्याणाम् एधि \\ इत्य् आरोहन्तम् अभिमन्त्रयते ॥
13.2.18.a.m: He addresses [the sacrificer] as he ascends with [the mantra,] 'Mount the heavenly seat; having mounted it, look forth; be the sole ruler of men.'

13.2.19.a.m: He proceeds with the rites beginning with the Māhendra cup.

13.2.20.a.m: Having brought forward the stotra for it, he consecrates [the sacrificer] by unction as in the piling of the fire altar.

13.2.21.a.s: rajasi stuvate saptabhir annapūrvābhir annahomaṃ juhoti grāmyāraṇyānām̐ samavadāya //
13.2.21.a.d: रजसि स्तुवते सप्तभिर् अन्नपूर्वाभिर् अन्नहोमं जुहोति ग्राम्यारण्यानाम्̐ समवदाय ॥
13.2.21.a.m: While they chant in the dust [or in the open space], he offers the food-oblation, taking portions together from both cultivated and wild [grains], with the seven [mantras] preceded by [the word] 'food'.

13.2.22.a.s: ( mādhyamdinasya savanasya ) madhyama ukthyaparyāye brahmasāmny upākṛte 'tra sārasvataprabhṛtīn uttarān ālabhante //
13.2.22.a.d: ( माध्यम्दिनस्य सवनस्य ) मध्यम उक्थ्यपर्याये ब्रह्मसाम्न्य् उपाकृते ऽत्र सारस्वतप्रभृतीन् उत्तरान् आलभन्ते ॥
13.2.22.a.m: When, at the midday pressing, in the middle ukthya round, the Brahmasāman has been introduced, they seize the later [animal victims] beginning with the one for Sarasvatī.

13.2.23.a.m: He proceeds with their omenta without basting them.

13.2.24.a.s: sārasvatasya vapayā pracarya samavadāya prājāpatyānāṃ vapābhiḥ pracarati //
13.2.24.a.d: सारस्वतस्य वपया प्रचर्य समवदाय प्राजापत्यानां वपाभिः प्रचरति ॥
13.2.24.a.m: Having proceeded with the omentum of the victim for Sarasvatī, he cuts off portions together and proceeds with the omenta of the victims for Prajāpati.

13.2.25.a.m: He proceeds with the wild-rice mess, beginning with the oblation offering and concluding with the iḍā.

13.2.26.a.m: The principal priests eat the remnant of the oblation.

13.2.27.a.m: At the time of the animal [portions], he proceeds with the deity offerings of all [victims] ending with the one for Sarasvatī.

13.2.28.a.s: ṣoḍaśicamasān unnayann ekasmai camasagaṇāya rājānam atirecayati / taiḥ pracaryātiriktastotrāya hotṛcamasamukhyāmmś camasān unnayati / stutaśastre bhavataḥ / śastraṃ pratigīrya prājāpatyānāṃ mukhyaṃ graham adhvaryur ādatte / ṛtvija itarān //
13.2.28.a.d: षोडशिचमसान् उन्नयन्न् एकस्मै चमसगणाय राजानम् अतिरेचयति । तैः प्रचर्यातिरिक्तस्तोत्राय होतृचमसमुख्याम्म्श् चमसान् उन्नयति । स्तुतशस्त्रे भवतः । शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य प्राजापत्यानां मुख्यं ग्रहम् अध्वर्युर् आदत्ते । ऋत्विज इतरान् ॥
13.2.28.a.m: Drawing the ṣoḍaśin cups, he leaves over the king [Soma] for one set of cups; having proceeded with them, he draws the cups beginning with the hotṛ's cup for the supplementary stotra; the stotra and śastra take place; having responded to the śastra, the adhvaryu takes the principal cup of the Prājāpatya offerings, and the other priests take the other [cups].

13.2.29.a.s: surāgrahāṇāṃ mukhyaṃ pratiprasthātā vājasṛta itarān ādatte / camasām̐ś camasādhvaryavaḥ //
13.2.29.a.d: सुराग्रहाणां मुख्यं प्रतिप्रस्थाता वाजसृत इतरान् आदत्ते । चमसाम्̐श् चमसाध्वर्यवः ॥
13.2.29.a.m: The pratiprasthātṛ takes the principal cup of surā, the chariot-runners take the others; and the camasa-adhvaryus take the [soma] cups.

13.2.30.a.s: saṃpṛcaḥ stha \ saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅkta \\ iti prāṅ adhvaryuḥ somagrahair uddravati / saṃpṛcaḥ stha \ saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅktām iti vā vipṛcaḥ stha \ vi papmanā pṛṅkta \\ iti pratyaṅ pratiprasthātā surāgrahaiḥ / vipṛcaḥ stha vi papmanā pṛṅktām iti vā //
13.2.30.a.d: संपृचः स्थ \ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्त \\ इति प्राङ् अध्वर्युः सोमग्रहैर् उद्द्रवति । संपृचः स्थ \ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्ताम् इति वा विपृचः स्थ \ वि पप्मना पृङ्क्त \\ इति प्रत्यङ् प्रतिप्रस्थाता सुराग्रहैः । विपृचः स्थ वि पप्मना पृङ्क्ताम् इति वा ॥
13.2.30.a.m: The adhvaryu runs forward toward the east with the soma cups with [the mantra,] 'You are combiners; combine me with prosperity'—or, 'May they combine me with prosperity'; the pratiprasthātṛ runs toward the west with the surā cups with [the mantra,] 'You are separators; separate [me] from evil'—or, 'May they separate [me] from evil.'

13.2.31.a.s: āhavanīyanyante somagrahair avatiṣṭhante / mārjālīyanyante surāgrahaiḥ pracarati / somagrahair vaṣaṭkārānuvāṣaṭkārau / surāgrahān anuprakampayanti / vyākhyātaḥ somasya bhakṣaḥ //
13.2.31.a.d: आहवनीयन्यन्ते सोमग्रहैर् अवतिष्ठन्ते । मार्जालीयन्यन्ते सुराग्रहैः प्रचरति । सोमग्रहैर् वषट्कारानुवाषट्कारौ । सुराग्रहान् अनुप्रकम्पयन्ति । व्याख्यातः सोमस्य भक्षः ॥
13.2.31.a.m: They stop near the āhavanīya fire with the soma cups; he proceeds near the mārjālīya fire with the surā cups; the call of vaṣaṭ and the second vaṣaṭ are made with the soma cups; they shake the surā cups in response; the consumption of the soma has been explained.
